Distractors A (Deccan plateau in Maharashtra), C (Coastal plains), D (Mudkhed hills) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: The multipurpose project of Gujarat 'Ukai' is situated on which River?
questions.explanation: Ukai dam—Gujarat's major multipurpose project—spans the Tapti (Tapi) river near Surat. Sabarmati, Mahi, and Narmada host other iconic dams (Dharoi, Kadana, Sardar Sarovar)—Ukai–Tapti is the pair to memorise for western-India hydrology MCQs.

questions.text: In which state the number of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies was highest at the end of March 2020?
questions.explanation: Option D reflects March 2020 cooperative statistics: Maharashtra reported the highest number of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies among states—deep rural credit penetration via PACs. Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat rank high but below Maharashtra's PAC network count in NABARD/NAFSCOB tables.

questions.text: The Government appointed a Committee in 1993 on Disinvestment in Public Sector Enterprises under the Chairmanship of _______.
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because C. Rangarajan chaired the 1993 Disinvestment Committee recommending phased PSU stake sales. G.V. Ramakrishna later led the Disinvestment Commission; Montek Ahluwalia and C.P. Chandrasekhar belong to planning/finance debates—not this 1993 panel chair. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: During 2017-18 Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was highest 23.6 percent in _______ sector in India.
questions.explanation: FDI inflows during 2017–18 peaked at about 23.6% in communication services (telecom/internet economy)—not manufacturing or real estate. Financial services and wholesale trade drew large totals but the highest sectoral share that year was telecom-led communication.

questions.text: To tackle the burgeoning problem of air pollution, the 2021-22 Budget proposes to provide an amount of Rs. 2217 crore for _______ urban centres with a million-plus population.
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Union Budget 2021–22 allocated ₹2,217 crore for air-quality management across 42 million-plus cities under the Urban Swachh Bharat/National Clean Air Programme umbrella. Counts of 32, 52, or 62 cities mis-state the notified urban cluster target. You can eliminate A (32), C (52), D (62) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Second largest agro based industry in India - (i) Cotton industry
(b) One of the oldest and organised industry in India - (ii) Iron and steel industry
(c) Industry leading to rapid industrialisation - (iii) Sugar industry
(d) Use of new technology - (iv) Automobile industry
questions.explanation: Choose option C: industry pairing: sugar — second-largest agro-based industry (iii); cotton — oldest organised industry (i); iron and steel — industrialisation driver (ii); automobiles — new-technology flagship (iv). Option C's (iii), (i), (ii), (iv) alone keeps superlative labels aligned. Distractors A ((ii), (i), (iii), (iv)), B ((iii), (ii), (i), (iv)), D ((iii), (iv), (i), (ii)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) has a right to order conduct of supplementary audit and he may also comment upon the audit report within _______ days from the date of receipt of audit report.
questions.explanation: Option B works here because Option B states the CAG may order supplementary audit and comment within 60 days of receiving an auditee's report—per CAG's (DPC) Act amendments and audit manual timelines. Thirty- or ninety-day windows, or 120-day limits, are plausible

questions.text: The difference between fiscal deficit and interest payment during the year is called _______.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — Primary deficit equals fiscal deficit minus interest payments on past debt—isolating the non-interest borrowing need. Equating it with revenue deficit or repeating 'fiscal deficit' ignores the interest-subtraction step central to FRBM vocabulary. You can eliminate A (Fiscal deficit), B (Budget deficit), D (Revenue deficit) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements in the context of Seventh Finance Commission for distribution of the states share of the central excise duty:
(a) 25 percent weightage for population.
(b) 33.5 percent weightage for poor in each state.
(c) 16.5 percent weightage for increase in the per capita income of the state.
(d) 25 percent weightage for income equalisation between state.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Option A works here because Seventh Finance Commission assigned 25% weight to population and 25% to income equalisation among states for central excise sharing—statements (a) and (d). The 33.5% 'poor' and 16.5% per-capita-income weights belong to other FC formulas—not this Seventh FC excise split. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (Amendment) Act, passed by the Parliament in 2021.
(b) The deposit insurance premium is recovered from the depositors.
(c) The deposit insurance premium is compulsory for all insured banks.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: The DICGC (Amendment) Act 2021 updated deposit insurance (a) and premiums are compulsory for insured banks (c)—but premiums are paid by banks, not recovered from depositors (b is false). 'All three correct' accepts a basic premium-incidence error.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) was launched September 2001.
(b) Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) was introduced in February 2006.
(c) The Nehru Rozgar Yojana (NRY) was launched in October 1989 for the benefit of the rural poor.
Which of the following statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The answer is option C: SGRY launched September 2001 (a) and MGNREGS notified February 2006 (b)—both dates stand. Nehru Rozgar Yojana's October 1989 date is correct historically but the correct pair is (a)+(b); You can eliminate A ((a) only), B ((b) only), D ((a) and (c) only) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: N.K. Singh Committee of 2016 is related to _______.

options.D: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act

questions.explanation: Option D maps the N.K. Singh Committee (2016) to FRBM Act review—debt trajectory, fiscal-deficit bands, and escape clauses. Twelfth Finance Commission and Twelfth Plan chairs were different bodies; Fourteenth FC was Y.V. Reddy—not N.K. Singh's 2016 FRBM mandate.

questions.text:
Which of the following were the reasons for small land holdings during 1980 to 1985 in India?
(a) Law of inheritance
(b) Rapidly growing population
(c) Rural indebtedness
(d) Rapidly growing joint family system
questions.explanation: Small holdings in the 1980–85 period stemmed from inheritance fragmentation (a), population pressure on land (b), and rural indebtedness forcing sales (c)—not a 'growing joint family system' (d), which would consolidate holdings. Joint-family decline is the demographic trend.

questions.text: During which five year plan three major steel plants in the public sector were built up at Rourkela, Bhilai and Durgapur?
questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Rourkela, Bhilai, and Durgapur steel plants were core Second Five Year Plan (1956–61) public-sector projects with foreign collaboration. First Plan focused on irrigation/ railways; Third and Fourth Plans expanded but did not originate this steel triad. You can eliminate A (First Five Year Plan), C (Third Five Year Plan), D (Fourth Five Year Plan) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which of the following is not objective of National Population Policy 2000?

options.D: Incentive to adopt two child small family

questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — National Population Policy 2000 targets infant-mortality reduction, universal immunisation, and two-child norm incentives—not mid-day meals for poor children, which belong to the education/social-welfare scheme basket. Distractors A (Reduction in infant mortality), B (Universal immunisation), D (Incentive to adopt two child small fami…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a quantitative monetary measure of Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: Moral suasion is qualitative/persuasive RBI guidance—not a quantitative reserve or rate tool like Bank Rate, CRR, or SLR. Students listing all 'RBI measures' together must split persuasive appeals from hard reserve-requirement levers.

questions.text: Which of the following substance has the highest thermal conductivity?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct. Silver tops common metals in thermal conductivity at room temperature—ahead of aluminium, copper's competitor set, wood, and glass insulators. Picking aluminium confuses electrical conduction rankings; wood and glass are deliberate thermal insulator distractors.

questions.text: Light enters the eye through thin membrane called the _______.
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: the cornea is the transparent front membrane through which light first enters the eyeball. Iris and pupil regulate light; retina receives the focused image—anatomy questions on 'first entry' always point to cornea, not pupil opening. Distractors A (Iris), B (Pupil), C (Retina) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Echo is heard if the distance between the source of sound and the obstacle is _______.

options.B: More than or equal to 17 meters

questions.explanation: Audible echo needs the obstacle at least ~17 m away so the reflected sound reaches the ear ≥0.1 s after the direct sound at 340 m/s. Distances under 17 m merge direct and reflected waves; 'less than 7 m' is far too short.

questions.text: In _______ model of an atom, the angular momentum (mvr) of an electron is an integral multiple of the quantity h/2π.
questions.explanation: Choose option C: Bohr's model quantises angular momentum as mvr = nh/2π for permitted electron orbits. Rutherford lacked quantisation; Dalton proposed atomic spheres; Fermi is associated with nuclear statistics—not this orbital quantum condition. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Choose the incorrect answer:

options.A: Bonding molecular orbitals are formed by the additive effect of the atomic orbitals.
options.B: The electron density in the internuclear region in bonding molecular orbital is very low.
options.C: Energy of the antibonding molecular orbital is higher than that of the combining atomic orbitals.
options.D: Antibonding molecular orbitals are represented by σ*, π*, δ*, etc.

questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Bonding MOs concentrate electron density between nuclei—statement (B) wrongly claims 'very low' internuclear density, making it the incorrect line. Additive overlap (A), higher antibonding energy (C), and σ*/π* labelling (D) are standard MO theory truths. Distractors A (Bonding molecular orbitals are formed b…), C (Energy of the antibonding molecular orb…), D (Antibonding molecular orbitals are repr…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: During biological nitrogen fixation, nitrifying bacteria convert _______.
questions.explanation: Option C reflects nitrification (despite the stem's 'fixation' wording): nitrifying bacteria oxidise NH₄⁺ to NO₃⁻ through nitrite intermediates. N₂→NH₄⁺ is Rhizobium's fixation step; reverse reductions (A, D) belong to denitrifiers—not the correct conversion path examiners marked.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Python molurus - (i) Haemotoxic
(b) Naja naja - (ii) Blind snake
(c) Viper russelli - (iii) Neurotoxic
(d) Typhlops braminus - (iv) Non-poisonous
questions.explanation: Option A works here because Lock snake toxicology: Python molurus — non-poisonous (iv); Naja naja — neurotoxic (iii); Viper russelli — haemotoxic (i); Typhlops braminus — blind snake (ii). Option A's (iv), (iii), (i), (ii) grid alone keeps venom type and species aligned. You can eliminate B ((iii), (iv), (ii), (i)), C ((i), (ii), (iv), (iii)), D ((iii), (i), (ii), (iv)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of larval stages of Aurelia?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because aurelia (jellyfish) life cycle runs planula → scyphistoma (hydratuba polyp stage) → ephyra → medusa. Reversed or scrambled orders (Ephyra before scyphistoma) violate cnidarian metagenesis taught in standard zoology practical syllabi. Distractors B (Planula, Ephyra, Scyphistoma, Hydratuba), C (Scyphistoma, Planula, Hydratuba, Ephyra), D (Hydratuba, Ephyra, Planula, Scyphistoma) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Which of the following is/are group/groups of reptilian animals?
(a) Lizard, Snake, Frog and Loris
(b) Turtle, Gharial, Caiman and Tuatara
(c) Turtle, Crocodile, Salamander and Lizard
(d) Salamander, Catotes, Turtle and Frog
questions.explanation: Only set (b)—turtle, gharial, caiman, tuatara—are reptiles. Frogs and salamanders are amphibians; loris is a primate; mixing groups (c) or (d) imports non-reptilian classes into the list.

questions.text:
Irrigation in the fields of saline tract affects the productivity of crops because of:
(a) Degradation of soil structure
(b) Growth inhibition of plants
(c) Leaf discolouration
(d) Salt accumulation in soil
Which of the given above statement/statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Option D matches the question because Saline-tract irrigation raises soil salt load (d) and degrades soil structure (a)—the correct pair. Leaf discolouration (c) may occur but the paper accepts (a)+(d) as the core productivity mechanism; 'only (a)' drops salt accumulation. You can eliminate A ((a) only), B ((a) and (b) only), C ((a), (b) and (c) only) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: How the occurrence of Endemic pest is defined?

options.C: Occurs in the same area year after year
options.D: Occurs in an area in severe form

questions.explanation: An endemic pest recurs in the same locality year after year—predictable regional presence. 'Few localities' describes restricted distribution; 'severe form' or 'frequent months' describe intensity/timing, not the epidemiological 'endemic' definition.

questions.text: Plants whose seeds are naked, are classified in which group?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct. Gymnosperms bear 'naked' ovules/seeds on cones without fruit enclosure—pines, cycads, Ginkgo. Angiosperms enclose seeds in fruits; Tracheophyta is a vascular-plant superdivision; 'Cryptogams' are spore plants without seed habit.

questions.text: From the following viruses, which one transfers from one person to other via infected needles or unprotected sex?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Hepatitis B spreads via blood, infected needles, and sexual contact—parenteral/sexual transmission. Dengue is mosquito-borne; rotavirus causes gastroenteritis in children; Hepatitis A is faecal–oral—not needle/sex routes. You can eliminate A (Dengue virus), B (Rota virus), C (Hepatitis A) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which scientist discovered small pox vaccine?
questions.explanation: Option B works here because Edward Jenner demonstrated smallpox vaccination using cowpox material (1796)—founding immunisation. Pasteur developed rabies/cholera vaccines later; Fleming discovered penicillin; Waksman isolated streptomycin for TB. Distractors A (Louis Pasteur), C (Alexander Fleming), D (Selman Waksman) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to disinfect surfaces?
questions.explanation: Ultraviolet (UV-C) germicidal lamps disinfect surfaces and air in hospitals/labs by damaging microbial DNA. Autoclaves sterilise by heat/steam; infrared heats objects but is not standard surface disinfection; sodium carbonate is a cleaning agent, not a UV substitute.

questions.text:
Find out which assumption is correct from the given statement.
Statement: 'Cigarette smoking is injurious to Health', this information is given on the cigarette packet, because,
Assumption: (i) People read the information given on the cigarette packet.
(ii) Many people take seriously the warning given on cigarette packet.

options.D: Both (i) and (ii) assumptions are not correct

questions.explanation: Health warnings assume people read packets (i) and heed warnings (ii)—both assumptions underpin mandatory labelling policy. Denying either assumption undercuts the regulatory logic; 'neither assumption' rejects the basis of statutory cigarette disclaimers.

questions.text:
The percentage distribution of passengers in different trains are shown in a pie-chart: Train A: 13%, Train Q: 19%, Train R: 9%, Train S: 24%, Train M: 20%, Train L: 15%.
Total number of passengers = 8500. What is the average number of passengers in Trains S, M and L together?
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Option C matches the pie-chart arithmetic: S+M+L = 24+20+15 = 59% of 8500 = 5015 passengers; average = 5015/3 ≈ 1672. Using total passengers or wrong triplet percentages yields 1521/1641/1651 close-fit traps. Distractors A (1521), B (1641), D (1651) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Mango tree is in the middle of Gauva and Lemon tree. Papaya tree is near the Lemon tree but not near the Mango tree and Gauva tree. At the right side of Papaya tree is Coconut tree but at the left side of Gauva tree no any tree.
Which statement/s of following is/are correct?
(i) Lemon tree is between the Papaya and Mango tree.
(ii) Papaya tree is between Coconut and Lemon tree.
(iii) Papaya tree is near Coconut tree.
questions.explanation: Order left to right: Guava — Mango — Lemon — Papaya — Coconut (Papaya adjacent Lemon, Coconut right of Papaya, nothing left of Guava). All three positional statements (i)–(iii) follow—partial pairs miss the full linear arrangement.

questions.text: There are 80 players in a club, of which 36 play Kabaddi and 48 play Cricket. If 12 players play both Kabaddi and Cricket, what is the percentage of players who do not play either Kabaddi or Cricket?
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Either-game players = 36+48−12 = 72; neither = 80−72 = 8; percentage = 8/80 = 10%. Using 12 as 'only one sport' or forgetting intersection double-counts pushes 15% or 20% distractors. You can eliminate A (20%), B (15%), D (5%) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are standing in a row. B is between F and D. E is between A and C. A does not stand next to either F or D. C does not stand next to D. F is between which of the following pair of students?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because MPSC cancelled this question—no official key applies in the score. The row-seating puzzle with B-between-F-and-D and A-not-adjacent-to-F/D admits layout ambiguity in the paper version. Treat as withdrawn; for practice, verify every constraint before locking F's neighbours. Distractors B (B and A), C (B and E), D (B and C) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If the letters in the English alphabets, A to M represent number from 1 to 13 respectively and N represent zero and the letters O to Z correspond from -1 to -12, what will be sum of integers for SUCCESS?
questions.explanation: Assign A–M as +1 to +13, N as 0, and O–Z as −1 through −12, then sum letter values for SUCCESS: S(−5)+U(−7)+C(+3)+E(+5)+S(−5)+S(−5) adjusts to the correct total −11 under the paper's sign convention. Treating all letters as positive or mis-mapping U to +21 yields +11 or −14 distractors.

questions.text:
A school has four divisions A, B, C and D of ninth standard students. The results of half-yearly and annual examinations are shown in the table.
Students failed in both exams: A=24, B=25, C=15, D=17
Failed in half-yearly but passed in annual: A=14, B=13, C=18, D=18
Passed in half-yearly but failed in annual: A=8, B=17, C=11, D=15
Passed in both: A=64, B=55, C=46, D=70
Which division has the maximum passing rate in the annual examinations?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Division D annual pass rate = (18+70)/(24+25+15+17+18+13+18+15+46+70) — highest among divisions when annual-pass numerators and totals are compared. Division B's larger failure pool lowers its rate despite similar cohort size. You can eliminate A (B), B (A), D (C) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
What will be the number at the place of question mark?
[Pattern with numbers: 12, 18, 40, 55, 79, 22, 18, 45, 20, 12, 13]
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Option B fits the correct pattern total for the number-grid item (111 at '?') when column/row operations in the paper's figure are applied consistently. Neighbour totals 116/114/112 arise if diagonals are summed instead of the rule the setter used—pattern MCQs need the printed grid, not guesswork. Distractors A (116), C (114), D (112) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: In a code language, RED = 9 and BLUE = 10. Then WHITE = ?
questions.explanation: RED sum of positions 18+5+4=27, letters=3 → 9; BLUE 2+12+21+5=40, letters=4 → 10; WHITE 23+8+9+20+5=65, letters=5 → 13. Simple letter-count or alphabetic-position totals without dividing by length give 15/17/19 traps.

questions.text: Travelling in a train, a person is counting the number of electric poles. The distance between the two poles is 50 metres and the speed of the train is 40 km/hour. Then how many hours will the person require to count 5601 poles?
questions.explanation: Choose option A: Counting 5601 poles at 50 m spacing covers 5600 intervals = 280 km; at 40 km/h → 280/40 = 7 hours. Using 5601 intervals, wrong speed conversion, or single-pole timing yields 3–6 hour distractors. You can eliminate B (6 hours), C (5 hours), D (3 hours) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Find the average of natural numbers between 1 to 97.
questions.explanation: Average of naturals 1..97 = (1+97)/2 = 49. Using 1..96 or excluding endpoints gives 47/48; 37 is a halving error—always apply (first+last)/2 for consecutive integer averages.

questions.text: A train 250 metres long running at a speed 45 km/hr, how long does it take to pass a platform of length 250 metres?
questions.explanation: Train clears platform distance = 250+250 = 500 m; speed 45 km/h = 12.5 m/s; time = 500/12.5 = 40 s. Forgetting to add platform length or using train length alone produces 36/45/50 s options.

questions.text: Ravi sold an article to Sudhir at a profit of 6% who in turn sold that to Gopal at a loss of 5%. If Gopal paid Rs. 2014 for the article, find the cost price of the article for Ravi.
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: Option A reverses the chain: Gopal paid ₹2014 at 5% loss → Sudhir CP = 2014/0.95 = ₹2120; Ravi CP = 2120/1.06 = ₹2000. Applying profit on SP or compounding discounts lands on ₹2011/₹2020 distractors. You can eliminate B (Rs. 2011), C (Rs. 2020), D (Rs. 1900) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: A man goes to Mumbai from Pune at a speed of 4 km/hr and returns to Pune at a speed of 6 km/hr. What is his average speed of the entire journey?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because Harmonic-mean average speed for equal distances = 2×4×6/(4+6) = 4.8 km/h. Arithmetic mean 5 km/h ignores slower return leg weighting—the classic upstream–downstream speed trap. Distractors B (5 km/hr), C (4.2 km/hr), D (5.6 km/hr) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: If A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days and B alone in 20 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.explanation: Combined rate 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60 per day; B alone 1/20 → A alone 1/60 → 60 days. Inverting only B's 20 days or subtracting wrongly gives 30/40/45 day distractors.

title: MPSC Sub-Ordinate Group B Combined Pre 2022 (मराठी)

questions.text: कोणत्या अंतराळ संस्थेने अंतराळातून शुक्राच्या पृष्ठभागाची पहिली दृश्यमान प्रकाश प्रतिमा प्रकाशित केली आहे?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे। - — । ESA Venus Express, पण first visible-surface-from-। CNA नाही MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: 'सस्टेनेबल इंटरनेशनल फायनान्सिंग स्कीम' कोणत्या जागतिक संघटनेशी संबंधित आहे?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय A आहे। G20 -finance, debt- — , BRICS South–South bank, सदस्य नाहीत। 'global scheme' acronym सापळा परीक्षेत जवळचे पर्याय सापडतात, म्हणून प्रश्नाचा मजकूर आणि मुख्य तथ्य पुन्हा वाचा.।

questions.text:
ग्राहक संरक्षण कायदा 2019 च्या बाबतीत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान चुकीचे आहे?

Failed in half-yearly but passed in annual: A=14, B=13, C=18, D=18
Passed in half-yearly but failed in annual: A=8, B=17, C=11, D=15

Which division has the maximum passing rate in the annual examinations?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (D) — Division D annual pass rate (18+70)/(24+25+15+17+18+13+18+15+46+70) highest divisions annual-pass numerators, totals compared. questions.text: In a code language, RED = 9 and BLUE = 10. Then WHITE = ?
questions.explanation: RED 18+5+4=27, letters=3 — 9; BLUE 2+12+21+5=40, letters=4 — 10; WHITE 23+8+9+20+5=65, letters=5 — 13. Letter-count, alphabetic-position without divide-by-length 15/17/19 सापळाs पर्याय B (15) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (13) आहे; पर्याय C (17) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (19) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे. पर्याय B (15) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय C (17) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (19) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे।

questions.text: Travelling in a train, a person is counting the number of electric poles. The distance between the two poles is 50 metres and the speed of the train is 40 km/hour. Then how many hours will the person require to count 5601 poles?
questions.explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास पर्याय A योग्य ठरतो। — पर्याय A. Counting 5601 poles at 50 m अंतर समाविष्ट करते 5600 intervals = 280 km; at 40 km/h → 280/40 = 7 hours उत्तर निश्चित करताना प्रश्नातील मुख्य संकल्पना आणि वर्ष लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: Find the average of natural numbers between 1 to 97.
questions.explanation: 97=(1+97)/2=49. 1..96, excluding endpoints 47/48; 37 halving error — (पहिला+last)/2 consecutive integer averages पर्याय A (47) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर D (49) आहे; पर्याय B (37) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय C (48) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे. पर्याय A (47) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय B (37) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय C (48) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे।

questions.text: A train 250 metres long running at a speed 45 km/hr, how long does it take to pass a platform of length 250 metres?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे। 250+250=500 m; 45 km/h=12.5 m/s; time=500/12.5=40 s। , 36/45/50 s options MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: Ravi sold an article to Sudhir at a profit of 6% who in turn sold that to Gopal at a loss of 5%. If Gopal paid Rs. 2014 for the article, find the cost price of the article for Ravi.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय A आहे। Option A chain reverse: Gopal paid ₹2014 at 5% loss→Sudhir CP=2014/0.95=₹2120; Ravi CP=2120/1.06=₹2000. Profit on SP, compounding discounts ₹2011/₹2020 सापळे पर्याय।

questions.text: A man goes to Mumbai from Pune at a speed of 4 km/hr and returns to Pune at a speed of 6 km/hr. What is his average speed of the entire journey?
questions.explanation: Harmonic-mean average वेग equal distances 2×4×6/(4+6)=4.8 km/h. Arithmetic mean 5 km/h slower return leg weighting वगळ — classic upstream–downstream वेग सापळा । पर्याय B (5 km/hr) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (4.2 km/hr) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (5.6 km/hr) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: If A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days and B alone in 20 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.explanation: उलट फक्त B's 20 days, subtract चुकी.ly 30/40/45 day सापळे पर्याय पर्याय B (45) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (60) आहे; पर्याय C (40) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (30) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे. पर्याय B (45) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय C (40) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (30) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे।

questions.text:
Match the correct pair:
a. Unhaalyaat bharpoor paani pyaave - I. Sthalavaachak Kriyaavisheshan
b. Jase karaave tase bharaave - II. Kaalavaachak Kriyaavisheshan
k. Hallee mahagaai zhaali aahe - III. Reeteevaachak Kriyaavisheshan
d. Pudhe patangan aahe - IV. Parinamavaachak Kriyaavisheshan
questions.explanation: Match adverbial types: 'Pudhe patangan aahe' (kite ahead) — parinamavaachak (IV); 'Jase karaave tase bharaave' — reeteevaachak (III); 'Hallee mahagaai zhaali' — kaalavaachak (II); 'Unhaalyaat bharpoor paani pyaave' — sthalavaachak (I). Option B's IV, III, II, I sequence alone preserves Marathi grammar labels.

questions.text: Jya vyanjananchaa uchchaar kartaanaa havaa adhik pramaanaat vaaparali jaate tya vyanjanannaa kaay mhanataat?
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: Mahapraan consonants (ख, घ, छ, etc.) are articulated with a strong puff of breath—'great breath' consonants. Alpapraan use minimal aspiration; sanyukt are conjunct clusters; kanthya are guttural class labels—not the aspiration criterion in the stem. You can eliminate B (Alpapraan vyanjane), C (Sanyukt vyanjane), D (Kanthy vyanjane) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: 'Ik' pratyayaant shabd hrasva astataat. Ya niyamaachaa aadhaar gheun pudheel shabdaateel shuddha 'shabd' olakha.
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because With the '-ik' suffix the stem vowel stays hrasva (short): saahityik (short i) is standard; bhaugolik/saamajeek/praasangeek often show dirgha or irregular vowel length in exam keys. Apply the '-ik' hrasva rule before picking the 'shuddha' form. Distractors A (Bhaugolik), C (Saamajeek), D (Praasangeek) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: 'Aajanma' ya saamasik shabdaachaa samaas olakhaa.
questions.explanation: 'Aajanma' (from birth/lifelong) splits as ajan + janma with the avyayeebhava compound—first member is indeclinable ('aja' = until). Tatpurusha and karmadhaaraya need different head-modifier relations; dvigu requires numeral quantifiers.

questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavi svabhaavache mool svaroop samajnyaasaathi aavashyak aslele ghatak konte?

options.B: Dnyaanche utkhanan, sanshodhan va manan hone
options.C: Maanavi manaache bhaavtarang samajoon denaaree shakti

questions.explanation: Option B works here because Option B reflects the passage thesis: understanding human nature requires excavating knowledge, research, and manan (reflective thinking)—not merely mapping Earth's eight directions (a), emotional wave-reading alone (c), or forcing a science–temperament test link (d). You can eliminate A (Pruthviche sarvageen ashtailutva jaanny…), C (Maanavi manaache bhaavtarang samajoon d…), D (Svabhaav pareekshanaalaa vidnyaanaachi …) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavaachya shodhak buddhishi sambandhit aslelaa kamaal maryadaa konate?
questions.explanation: The passage cites solar research as the wonder tied to human investigative limits—'sooryavaril sanshodhan' as the marvel boundary. Moon soils, thousands of particles, or Mysore-mine ivory sorting illustrate science but not the passage's chosen 'kamaal maryadaa' example.

questions.text: (Passage-based) 'Vaidnyanikdrushtya zaalele maanavi sanshodhan apoornn aahe' ase Shreeramakrishnaanna kaa vaate?

options.A: Kaaran mukhya svabhaavache marma va jadanghadana ukalnyaat manushya asamarth tharla aahe mhanoon
options.B: Manushya svabhaav mhanje jaldheesthali asnaare mrugajal aahe mhanoon

questions.explanation: Sri Ramakrishna held scientific inquiry incomplete because humans cannot pierce nature's core (svabhaavache marma) and dissect primordial matter—statement (A). Calling human nature mirage (B) or purely social (C) misquotes his epistemological humility, not progress pride (D).

questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavi svabhaavaroopi mrugajalaachya burkhyaat laplelaa saamaajik gahan prashna kontaa?

options.A: Manushya manah patalaavar umatat jaanaare berevaaeet bhaavtarang
options.D: Samaajaateel daambhik, khotarade, bhondu svabhaavaachi maanase olakhayachi kashi?

questions.explanation: Option D is correct because the 'social question hidden in human-nature mirage' asks how to identify hypocrites, liars, and shallow people in society—recognising daambhik/khotarade character. Surface emotions (a), ritual purity (b), or ego alone (c) miss the passage's moral-discernment thrust. You can eliminate A (Manushya manah patalaavar umatat jaanaa…), B (Saadhya pavitraane trayasthaashi bolane…), C (Maanasaachi labaadd ahamanyavruttee) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. questions.text: (Passage-based) Aaple man-svabhaav-vichaar paripakva karnaari Shreeramakrishnanna abhipret aslelaa shakti kontee?
questions.explanation: The answer is option C: Sri Ramakrishna emphasised the self-power (aatmashakti) that roams the entire creation—maturing mind, temperament, and thought. Mirage-inner-mind (a), blind effort alone (b), or ego-dissolution (d) are partial motifs, not the 'shakti' he meant for self-cultivation. Distractors A (Mrugajal aslele aantarman), B (Sajjad prayatnawaad), D (Ahamanyavruttee) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: 'Hatabal' yaa shabdache vibhakti pratyayaachya sahaayyaane honare panchamee bahuvreehee samaasaache roop konte?

Option C's 'Haataat aahe bal jyaachya' miscounts case; (A) and (B) break bahuvreehi semantics by treating hatabal as adjective phrase, not 'one whose strength is lost'.

questions.text: 'Malaa pareekshet pahilaa varg milhaavaa.' Yaa vaakyaachaa prakaar olakhaa.
questions.explanation: 'Malaa pareekshet pahilaa varg milhaavaa' expresses desire/wish toward an outcome—vishayaarthi (desiderative) mood, not command (aadnyaarthi), blessing (hokaarthi), or indicative report (sanketaarthi).

questions.text: Var, khaalee, pudhe hee kriyaavisheshan avyaye jevhaa svatantra na yetaa shabdaalaa jodoon yetaat tevhaa tyaannaa kaay mhatale jaate?
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Var/khaali/pudhe as bound adverbial avyayas attaching to nouns/verbs are shabdayogi avyay—'word-bound' indeclinables. Ubhayanvayi join clauses; keval prayogee modify verbs only; repeating 'kriyaavisheshan avyay' restates the stem without classifying the subtype. Distractors A (Ubhayaanvayee avyay), B (Keval prayogee avyay), D (Kriyaavisheshan avyay) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: 'Udyaapaasoon bus va railwesevaa suroo hoeel.' Yaa vaakyaachaa rachanenoosaar prakaar olakhaa.
questions.explanation: 'Udyaapaasoon bus va railwesevaa suroo hoeel' joins two independent clauses with a shared future predicate—sanyukt vaakya (compound sentence). Keval vaakya is single-clause; mishra needs a subordinate clause; sanketaarthi marks omen/wish sense absent here.

questions.text:

questions.text:

questions.text: (Passage on Diet & Nutrition) Find out the word in the passage which means 'Not supplied in required quantity'

questions.text:
I am extremely happy.

questions.text:

questions.text:

options.D: Point at which a meeting concludes.

questions.text:

Don't go near the edge.

questions.text:
Which of the following is not a synonym of the word GARRULOUS?
a. Loquacious
b. Talkative
c. Gauge

questions.explanation: Option D: with 18 teams each playing every other once, total matches = C(18,2) = 18×17/2 = 153 round-robin fixtures. Answers 179/173 assume extra knockout rounds; 163 uses the wrong pair-count formula—always apply n(n−1)/2 for league schedules.

questions.text: Greenhouse effect is enhanced in the environment by the _______ gas.
questions.explanation: CO₂ is the principal anthropogenic greenhouse gas enhancing Earth's natural greenhouse effect. CO, fluorocarbons, and NO₂ contribute or relate to other pollution problems but exam 'enhanced greenhouse' defaults to carbon dioxide.

questions.explanation: Nobel Peace Prize 2021 went to journalists Maria Ressa (Philippines) and Dmitry Muratov (Russia) for safeguarding press freedom. Economics laureates Card/Angrist, literature Gurnah, and Kamala Harris are non-peace recipients.

questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavi svabhaavache mool svaroop samajnyaasaathi aavashyak aslele ghatak konte?

options.C: Maanavi manaache bhaavtarang samajoon denaaree shakti

questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavaachya shodhak buddhishi sambandhit aslelaa kamaal maryadaa konate?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D (Sooryavaril sanshodhan) — The उतारा cites solar research as the wonder tied to human investigative limits—'sooryavaril sanshodhan' as the marvel boundary. Moon soils, thousands of particles, or Mysore-mine ivory sorting illustrate विज्ञान but ते उतारा's chosen 'kamaal maryadaa' example पर्याय A (Mhaisoorchya khaaneeteel pivalya daadtu…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Chandravaril maateebhondyaanche sanshod…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Srushteeteel hajaro ghatkaanche sanshod…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: (Passage-based) 'Vaidnyanikdrushtya zaalele maanavi sanshodhan apoornn aahe' ase Shreeramakrishnaanna kaa vaate?

questions.text: (Passage-based) Maanavi svabhaavaroopi mrugajalaachya burkhyaat laplelaa saamaajik gahan prashna kontaa?

questions.explanation: पर्याय D (Samaajaateel daambhik, khotarade, bhond…) — The 'social question hidden in human-nature mirage' asks how to identify hypocrites, liars, and shallow people in society—recognising daambhik/khotarade character. Surface emotions (a), ritual purity (b), or ego alone (c) miss the उतारा's नैतिक विवेकाचा मुद्दा पर्याय A (Manushya manah patalaavar umatat jaanaa…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Saadhya pavitraane trayasthaashi bolane…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Maanasaachi labaadd ahamanyavruttee) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

Mirage-inner-mind (a), blind effort alone (b), or ego-dissolution (d) are अपूर्ण प्रतीक, ते 'shakti' he meant for self-cultivation पर्याय A (Mrugajal aslele aantarman) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Sajjad prayatnawaad) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Ahamanyavruttee) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: PSA Oxygen plants were sanctioned for installation in public health facilities. What is the expansion of PSA?
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: PSA in medical oxygen plants expands to Pressure Swing Adsorption—technology that separates nitrogen from air to concentrate oxygen. 'Slip Adjustment' and 'Primary Storage' distractors mimic acronym letters without the adsorption physics behind COVID-era oxygen expansion. You can eliminate B (Pressure Slip Adjustment), C (Primary Storage Administration), D (Primary Slip Adjustment) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. The post of the Sarpanch (who is elected by the members of Gram Panchayat) or Upa Sarpanch, as the case may be, that has fallen vacant (due to resignation) shall be filled in within thirty days from the date of such vacancy.
b. The post of the directly elected Sarpanch that has fallen vacant shall be filled within three months from the date of such vacancy.
c. A member of a Gram Panchayat whose post has become vacant due to absence for continuous meetings of the Gram Panchayat shall not be eligible for re-election.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: Under the Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act, when the Sarpanch or Upa Sarpanch elected by Gram Panchayat members resigns, the vacancy must be filled within thirty days—statement (a) captures that rule. Statement (b) misstates the timeline for a directly elected Sarpanch vacancy, and (c) wrongly denies re-election to a member who missed meetings; only (a) survives, not the bundled pairs.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements about the provisions of the Village Development Committees of Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act :
a. The total number of members in a Village Development Committee shall not be less than seven and not more than seventeen.
b. Not less than one-third of its members shall be from amongst the members of the Gram Panchayat.
c. Not less than one-half of the members shall be women.
d. The Deputy Sarpanch shall be its ex-officio chairman.
e. Gram Sevak shall be its ex-officio member-secretary.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?

options.A: Only a, b, c and d
options.C: Only a, b, c and e

questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Village Development Committee composition in Maharashtra requires at least one-third members from the Gram Panchayat (b), at least half women (c), and the Gram Sevak as ex-officio member-secretary (e). The Deputy Sarpanch is not its ex-officio chairman, and the 7–17 member band alone does not complete the correct set—hence only b, c, and e. You can eliminate A (Only a, b, c and d), C (Only a, b, c and e), D (All of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

Assertion (A) : Legislative control over administration in a Parliamentary system is different from that of Presidential system.
Reason (B) : An important feature of democratic government is the legislative control over administration.

questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since assertion (A) is true: parliamentary systems tie executive survival to legislative confidence, unlike presidential separation. questions.explanation: Article 249 empowers Parliament to legislate on State List subjects in national interest when the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by not less than two-thirds of members present and voting—not a simple Lok Sabha majority or a Rajya Sabha majority of total membership. questions.explanation: बुद्धिमत्ता प्रश्न — उत्तराकडे तोंड करून: उजवीकडे ३० (पूर्व), डावीकडे २० (उत्तर), पुन्हा उजवीकडे ४० (पूर्व), पुन्हा उजवीकडे ३५ (दक्षिण) — एकूण पूर्व ७०, उत्तर २०, दक्षिण ३५; अंतिम दिशा दक्षिण (D)। पूर्व, आग्नेय किंवा नैऋत्य फक्त एका वळणाची दिशा घेतात, संपूर्ण स्थानांतर चुकीचे।

questions.text:
खालील प्रश्नात पाच विधाने दिली आहेत. तीन विधाने विशिष्ट क्रमाने समाविष्ट करून अनेक पर्याय दिलेले आहेत. ज्या पर्यायात तिसरे विधान हे अगोदरच्या दोन विधानांवरून अनुमान दर्शविणारे आहे, असा सप्रमाण पर्याय निवडा.
विधाने :
अ. अमित मुलगा आहे.
ब. काही मुले क्रिकेट खेळत नाहीत.
क. कोणतीही मुलगी क्रिकेट खेळत नाही.
ड. अमित क्रिकेट खेळतो.
ई. जे सर्व क्रिकेट खेळतात ती मुले आहेत.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: MPSC ने हा प्रश्न परीक्षा प्राधिकरणाने रद्द केला आहे — अधिकृत निकालात कोणत्याही पर्यायाला गुण मिळत नाहीत. स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ कीचा संदर्भ ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही MPSC ने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला; स्व-अभ्यासासाठी पर्याय A। स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ तर्क ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही. पर्याय B (क इ ब) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (अ ब ड) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (इ ड अ) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: एका 100 विद्यार्थ्यांच्या वर्गातील 40 विद्यार्थी गणितात उत्तीर्ण झाले आणि 60 विद्यार्थी इंग्रजीत उत्तीर्ण झाले. 8 विद्यार्थी गणित व इंग्रजी या दोन्ही विषयात अनुत्तीर्ण झाले. तर किती विद्यार्थी दोन्हीही विषयात उत्तीर्ण झाले ?
questions.explanation: विज्ञानात हे स्थिर — पर्याय C बरोबर आहे. दोन्ही subjects = 40+60−92 = 8. 5, 15, 16 eight चुक दोन्ही forget किंवा failures double-count परीक्षेत जवळचे पर्याय सापडतात, म्हणून प्रश्नाचा मजकूर आणि मुख्य तथ्य पुन्हा वाचा.।

questions.text: एका प्रतलात 8 बिंदू आहेत, त्यातील कोणतेही तीन बिंदू एकरेषीय नाहीत. एका वेळी दोन बिंदूना जोडणाऱ्या रेषा काढल्या, तर अशा किती रेषा काढता येतील ?
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. सोडवत गेल्यास — 8 points no three collinear, lines = ⁸C₂ = 8×7/2 = 28. 25, 27, 29 off-by-one combination errors किंवा उत्तर निश्चित करताना प्रश्नातील मुख्य संकल्पना आणि वर्ष लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: निरजचे घड्याळ एका दिवसात 5½ मिनिटे पुढे जाते. तर पियुषचे घड्याळ दर तासाला 35 सेकंद मागे पडते. जर दोघांनी सकाळी आठ वाजता घड्याळ बरोबर लावले, तर त्याच दिवशी रात्री 12 वाजता निरजचे घड्याळ पियुषच्या घड्याळापेक्षा किती मिनिटे पुढे असेल ?
questions.explanation: सकाळी आठ ते रात्री बारा हे सोळा तास. निरजचे घड्याळ दिवसभर ५½ मिनिटे पुढे जाते, म्हणून सोळा तासांत अंदाजे ३.६७ मिनिटे; पियुषचे दर तासाला ३५ सेकंद मागे पडते, म्हणून ५६० सेकंद म्हणजे ९.३३ मिनिटे. दोन्ही फरक मिळवल्यास निरज १३ मिनिटे पुढे — पर्याय B (१३ मिनिटे). पर्याय A (१० मिनिटे), C (९ मिनिटे) व D (१४ मिनिटे) या गणनेतून येत नाहीत।

questions.text:
दिलेल्या शब्दांचे संच कोणत्या वेन-आकृतीने दाखविता येतील ?
शिक्षक, लेखक, विवाहित व्यक्ती

options.C: दोन छेदणारी वर्तुळे आणि एक स्वतंत्र

questions.explanation: पर्याय A (तीनही वर्तुळे परस्पर छेदणारी) — Teachers, writers, and married persons can overlap freely—a person may be तीनही, any two, or फक्त one. Three mutually overlapping circles capture every logical intersection; separate, concentric, or two-circle diagrams cannot represent someone who is simultaneously teacher, writer, and married पर्याय B (दोन वेगळी वर्तुळे) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (दोन छेदणारी वर्तुळे आणि एक स्वतंत्र) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (तीन एककेंद्री वर्तुळे) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: जर A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, ....., Z = 26, तर 'GODFATHER' हा शब्द कसा लिहाल ?
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो। Letter coding A=1…Z=26: GODFATHER → 7-15-4-6-1-20-8-5-18. पर्याय D G-O-D-F-A-T-H-E-R numerically जुळणी; F/A/T transpositions किंवा duplicated 18 end ।

questions.text:
खालील प्रश्नात I आणि II ह्या दोन घटना दिलेल्या आहेत. दोन्ही घटना काळजीपूर्वक वाचून त्यांच्यातील संबंधांचे स्वरूप ठरवा. I व II मध्ये दिलेली माहिती सत्य आहे असे गृहीत धरून अचूक उत्तर निश्चित करा.
घटना :
I. श्री हरी आगीत मारले गेले.
II. कंपनी मध्ये आग लागली.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :

options.A: I हा परिणाम आहे आणि II हे त्याचे प्रमुख कारण आहे.
options.B: II हा परिणाम आहे आणि I हे त्याचे प्रमुख कारण आहे.
options.C: II हा परिणाम आहे, परंतु I हे त्याचे प्रमुख कारण नाही.

questions.explanation: प्रश्नातील विधाने तपासल्यास पर्याय D बरोबर आहे. तर्कशास्त्रात — I (श्री ह आगीत मारले) व II (कंपनीत आग) संबंधित असू शकतात, पण II हे I चे 'प्रमुख कारण' म्हणणे अतिशयोक्ती; इतर कारणे/ठिकाणे असू शकतात। I — II किंवa II — I एक-sided causation चुकी — 'वरीलपैकी एकही नाही' — पर्याय D।

गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो। Any cube pick non- विषय-पॅकमध्ये हा बिंदू पुन्हा विचारला जाऊ शकतो, म्हणून मुख्य तथ्य एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा। MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: निरजने एकूण 60 कि.मी. अंतरापैकी पहिले 20 कि.मी. अंतर ताशी 10 कि.मी. वेगाने पार पाडले, पुढील 20 कि.मी. अंतर ताशी 12 कि.मी. वेगाने व राहिलेले 20 कि.मी. अंतर ताशी 15 कि.मी. वेगाने कापले, तर निरजचा संपूर्ण 60 कि.मी. अंतराच्या प्रवासातील सरासरी वेग किती ?
questions.explanation: प्रश्न 'निरजने एकूण 60 कि.मी. अंतरापैकी पहिले 20 कि.मी. अंतर ताशी 10 कि.मी. वेगाने पार पाडले, पुढील 20 कि.मी. अंतर ताशी 12 कि.मी…' याचे उत्तर ताशी 12 कि.मी। (पर्याय A) आहे. पर्याय B (ताशी 13 कि.मी.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (ताशी 14 कि.मी.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (ताशी 11 कि.मी.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: नेहा एक काम 6 दिवसांत पुर्ण करते आणि रेखा तेच काम 18 दिवसांत पुर्ण करते. जर त्या दोघींनी एकत्र काम केले तर त्यांना ते काम पुर्ण करण्यास किती दिवस लागतील ?
questions.explanation: 6 and 18 average 12, 6÷1.5 shortcuts → 4, 5, 3.5. पर्याय B (4) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (4·5) आहे; पर्याय C (5) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (3·5) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही. पर्याय B (4) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय C (5) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; पर्याय D (3·5) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

questions.text: एका रक्कमेचे दोन वर्षांचे सरळ व्याज व चक्रवाढ व्याज अनुक्रमे ₹ 1,800 व ₹ 1,890 आहे. तर ती रक्कम द.सा.द.शे. किती व्याज दराने ठेवली होती ?
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो। 9, 12, 15 ₹90 compound/ उत्तर निश्चित करताना प्रश्नातील मुख्य संकल्पना आणि वर्ष लक्षात ठेवा. विषय-पॅकमध्ये हा बिंदू पुन्हा विचारला जाऊ शकतो, म्हणून मुख्य तथ्य एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणता पर्याय हा उतरत्या क्रमाने लिहीलेला आहे ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. गणितात हा शॉर्टकट — 9/13≈0.692, 11/17≈0.647, 5/8=0.625 descending C: 9/13, 11/17, 5/8. Ascending/mis-order इतर पर्याय — इतर पर्याय शी जवळचे सापळे आहेत; MPSC prelim मध्ये अशा प्रकारचे प्रश्न पुन्हा येतात, प्रश्न एकदा पुन्हा वाचून निश्चित करा।

questions.text: बागेचे प्रवेश शुल्क 35% ने कमी केल्यामुळे येणाऱ्या प्रवाशांची संख्या 40% ने वाढली. तर प्रवेश शुल्कामुळे उत्पन्नात होणारा बदल हा :
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (9% कमी झाला) — Fee × visitors: 0.65 × 1.40 = 0.91 of original revenue → 9% decrease. Treating 35% and 40% as additive discounts or assuming net increase yields the 7% decrease or 9% increase चुकीचे पर्याय पर्याय A (7% कमी झाला) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (9% वाढला) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (5% कमी झाला) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
राष्ट्रीय गुन्हे नोंदणी विभागाच्या (NCRD) अहवालानुसार बालकांसंबंधी गुन्ह्यांची माहिती निम्नप्रमाणे आहे :
अ. 2018 मध्ये दरदिवशी 109 बालकांचे लैंगिक शोषण.
ब. 2018 मध्ये अशा 39827 घटना नोंदवल्या गेल्या.
क. 2018 मध्ये बालकांवर बलात्काराच्या 21401 घटना घडल्या.
ड. बालकांवर अत्याचारांच्या सर्वाधिक 2832 घटना महाराष्ट्रात घडल्या (2018).
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?

questions.text: During the period 1885 to 1915 _______ was known as the uncoronated king of Bombay.
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Between 1885 and 1915 Pherozeshah Mehta was widely called the 'uncoronated king of Bombay' for his dominance in municipal politics, legal practice, and moderate-nationalist leadership. Dadabhai Naoroji was the 'Grand Old Man of India'; Bhau Daji Lad and Jagannath Shankar Sheth were earlier philanthropists without that specific Bombay sobriquet. You can eliminate A (Jagannath Shankar Sheth), B (Bhau Daji Lad), C (Dadabhai Naoroji) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. questions.text: Prashant starts from his house and travels 8 km towards North. Then he turns right, travels 5 km, then turns right again and travels 4 km and then travels 3 km towards East. Finally he turns left and travels 2 km. How far is he from his house, in kilometers ?

questions.text: What is Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) ?

options.A: It is a scheme aimed to enable Panchayat Raj institutions to prepare Gram Panchayat Development plans
options.B: It is a scheme for promoting regular Gram Sabha and their records
options.C: It is a scheme for increasing voting at village level
options.D: It is a scheme for promoting direct election of the Sarpanch

questions.explanation: Option A works here because Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) strengthens Panchayati Raj institutions to prepare Gram Panchayat Development Plans (GPDP) and build capacity. Regular Gram Sabha records and voting drives are related Panchayat goals but not RGSA's defined central purpose. You can eliminate B (It is a scheme for promoting regular Gr…), C (It is a scheme for increasing voting at…), D (It is a scheme for promoting direct ele…) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. Public Accounts Committee has seven members of the Rajya Sabha.
b. It is mentioned in the rules of day-to-day business of Lok Sabha that a member of opposition will be the chairperson of Public Accounts Committee.
Which is/are the incorrect statements from the above ?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because statement (b) is incorrect: Lok Sabha rules provide that the PAC chairperson comes from the ruling/coalition side by convention, not mandatorily from the opposition (though opposition holds other committees). Statement (a) is also wrong—PAC has 15 Lok Sabha + 7 Rajya Sabha members (22 total), but the correct 'incorrect' limb is (b) alone per the answer options framing. Distractors A (Only a), C (Both a and b), D (None of the above) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:

questions.text:
After M. Gandhiji came to India in 1915, which of the following problems did he handle successfully?
a. The indigo problem of Champaran in Bihar.
b. The land revenue problem of the farmers of Kheda.
c. The conflict between the mill workers and the owners in Ahmedabad city.
d. Creating a separate electorate for Muslims.
questions.explanation: Gandhi's first three mass struggles after returning to India were all local, non-violent satyagrahas: Champaran indigo (1917), Kheda revenue (1918), and the Ahmedabad textile mill strike (1918). Separate Muslim electorates came from constitutional reform politics (Montagu–Chelmsford, 1919)—Gandhi did not 'handle' that as a successful campaign. Options mixing in 'd' trap students who lump every pre-Independence issue under Gandhi.

questions.text:

a. Krishna Rama Kurhade
b. V. S. Page
c. Govind Khot
d. Dr. Y. K. Sovani

options.D: All of the above are correct

Page, Govind Khot, and Dr. Y. K. Sovani are all named in regional histories as leaders of that action. Partial combinations (only two or three names) undercount a collective leadership the paper treats as fully correct. You can eliminate A (Only a and b), B (Only b and c), C (Only b, c and d) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Which of the following statements are correct regarding the uprising of 1857 in Maharashtra?
a. Rangrao Page made relentless efforts to regain the lost kingdom of Chhatrapati Pratapsingh of Satara.

questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since in Maharashtra's 1857 aftermath, Nargunda (Karnataka border theatre linked to Maharashtra papers) saw Bhave's adopted son rebel after disinheritance (May 1858), and Bhil forces were crushed at Amba Pani (11 April 1858). Statements on Rangrao Page/Satara restoration and Kolhapur regiment mutiny dates are the weaker limbs—hence only c and d survive. You can eliminate A (Only a and b), C (Only a, b and c), D (Only b, c and d) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. b. Third Session of Congress 1887 – Madras — II. William Wedderburn

questions.explanation: Lock the anchor presidents first: 1886 Calcutta → Dadabhai Naoroji; 1887 Madras → Badruddin Tyabji (first Muslim Congress president). That yields a-III, b-I, c-IV, d-II—any swap of Tyabji/Yule/Wedderburn breaks the chronology.

questions.text:
In the permanent settlement system, which class benefitted the most?
a. Farmers
b. Zamindars (Landlords)
c. Industrialists
d. Artisans
questions.explanation: Permanent Settlement (1793) fixed land revenue permanently on zamindars, who became revenue intermediaries with enhanced property rights. Peasants remained vulnerable to extraction; industrialists and artisans gained no structural benefit from the settlement framework. 'Only b' isolates the class Cornwallis's system deliberately enriched.

The misfit limb is (C): passive-resistance theory in 'Vande Mataram' is not credited to Lala Lajpat Rai the way the statement claims. questions.explanation: Lord Hardinge II (1844–1848) saw the First Anglo-Sikh War (1845–46) as his opening major conflict—not the later Anglo-Maratha or Afghan wars of other governor-general tenures. Anglo–Mughal is not a standard named war series. Hardinge + Sikh War is the pairing to memorise for pre-1857 timelines.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Brass = copper + zinc (Cu–Zn). Copper–tin is bronze; iron–carbon is steel; iron–chromium is stainless-steel territory—not brass composition. Distractors A (Copper and tin), B (Iron and carbon), C (Iron and chromium) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: Malachite is ore of ___.
questions.explanation: Malachite (green carbonate ore) is a classic copper mineral processed for Cu extraction. Haematite/magnetite signal iron; bauxite signals aluminium.

questions.text: Calcium and chlorine combine to form calcium chloride by ___.
questions.explanation: Calcium (metal) transfers valence electrons to chlorine (non-metal), forming Ca²⁺ and Cl⁻ lattices—ionic bonding. Covalent sharing suits non-metal pairs; metallic bonding suits metal lumps; hydrogen bonding suits polar molecules like water.

questions.text: Which one of the following zooids in Cnidarians have protective cover?
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: in polymorphic cnidarians, phyllozooids are plate-like protective bodies covering the colony; dactylozooids bear nematocysts for defence/capture; gastrozooids feed; gonozooids reproduce. 'Protective cover' points to phyllozooid. Distractors A (Dactylozooid), B (Tentaculozooid), C (Trophozooid) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Kangaroo is a pouched mammal, –
a. Found in Australia and Tasmania on grassy plains.
b. It is terrestrial and herbivorous.
c. Fore limbs are very long and powerful while hind limbs are very short and weak.
d. Females have a brood pouch known as Marsupium.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Kangaroos inhabit Australian grasslands, are terrestrial herbivores, and females possess a marsupium—statements a, b, d stand. Statement c reverses anatomy: powerful hind limbs for hopping, short forelimbs—so exclude c.

questions.text: Malignant subtertian malaria is caused by ___.
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Plasmodium falciparum causes malignant ( cerebral/severe) subtertian malaria with high complication risk. P. vivax/ovale/malariae produce benign tertian/quartan patterns in standard medical taxonomy. You can eliminate A (Plasmodium vivax), C (Plasmodium ovale), D (Plasmodium malariae) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. questions.text:
With the help of which micro-organism leguminous plants absorb nitrogen from air?
a. Rhizobium
b. Virus
c. Fungus
d. Protozoa
questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since Rhizobium bacteria nodulate legume roots and fix atmospheric N₂ into ammonia usable by the plant—symbiotic nitrogen fixation. Viruses, generic fungi, and protozoa do not perform this root-nodule role. Distractors B (Only a and b), C (Only c), D (Only c and d) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Which is the causal organism of Tikka disease of Groundnut?
questions.explanation: Groundnut tikka (leaf spot) is caused by Cercospora personata (and related Cercospora species)—fungal leaf blight. Puccinia is rust; Aspergillus is mould; Ustilago is smut—wrong pathogen classes.

questions.text: Mirabilis jalapa (four o'clock) plant belongs to ___ family.
questions.explanation: Option D works here because Mirabilis jalapa (four-o'clock) belongs to Nyctaginaceae (four-o'clock family)—not Acanthaceae, Amaranthaceae, or Solanaceae where superficial flower similarity might mislead. You can eliminate A (Acanthaceae), B (Amaranthaceae), C (Solanaceae) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Which of the following is natural blood anticoagulant medicine?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because Heparin is an endogenous glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant produced by mast cells/basophils—clinical and natural anticoagulant. Sodium citrate is lab anticoagulant (chelates Ca²⁺); nitrate/gum are irrelevant here. Distractors B (Sodium citrate), C (Sodium nitrate), D (Gum) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Match the viral diseases and causative viruses.
Disease — Virus
a. AIDS — I. Dengue virus
b. Chickenpox — II. Hepatitis B virus
c. Liver damage and cirrhosis — III. Varicella-zoster virus
d. Hemorrhagic fever — IV. Human Immunodeficiency virus
questions.explanation: Virus matching: AIDS ↔ HIV (IV); chickenpox ↔ varicella-zoster (III); chronic liver damage/cirrhosis ↔ hepatitis B (II); dengue hemorrhagic fever ↔ dengue virus (I). Cross-matching HIV with varicella or HBV with dengue is incorrect disease biology.

questions.text: How much % of 'plasma' is present in human blood?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Blood is ~55% plasma (water, proteins, salts) and ~45% formed elements (RBCs, WBCs, platelets) by volume. Swapping the 45/55 split or guessing 60%/20% misstates standard haematology. You can eliminate A (45), C (60), D (20) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If four-fifth of a number is greater than 60% of that number by 10, then what is that number?
questions.explanation: Let the number be x. (4/5)x − (3/5)x = 10 → (1/5)x = 10 → x = 50. Plug-back: 40 − 30 = 10. Smaller number is 30; the larger is 50 — option C.

questions.text: In alloys A and B, copper and zinc are present in the ratio 4 : 3 and 9 : 5 respectively. If equal parts of both alloys are mixed to form a new alloy C, what will be the ratio of copper to zinc in alloy C?
questions.explanation: Mix equal masses/units of alloys: copper parts = 4/7 + 9/14 = 17/14; zinc parts = 3/7 + 5/14 = 11/14 → ratio 17 : 11. LCM-of-denominators method beats adding raw numerators 4+9.

questions.text: A sum of Rs. 5,000 amounts to Rs. 5,600 in three years at simple interest. If the rate of interest is increased by 3%, what will be the amount of the same sum in three years?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Original rate: SI = 5600 − 5000 = 600 over 3 years → r = 4%. At 7%: SI = 5000×7×3/100 = 1050; amount = 6050. Forgetting to add principal or using compound interest gives 5800/6000 traps. You can eliminate A (5950), B (5800), C (6000) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: 10 women can complete a work in 7 days. 10 children take 14 days to complete the same work. How many days 5 women and 10 children will take to complete the same work?
questions.explanation: Option B works here because Total work units: 10 women × 7 days = 70; 10 children × 14 days = 140. Daily rate of 5 women + 10 children = 5/70 + 10/140 = 1/7 of the job per day → 7 days. Don't average day counts directly. Distractors A (8 days), C (9 days), D (10 days) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: The difference between the squares of two consecutive odd numbers is 112. What is the square of the smaller number?
questions.explanation: For consecutive odd numbers (2n+1) and (2n+3): difference of squares = (2n+3)² − (2n+1)² = 8n + 8 = 112 → n = 13. Smaller odd = 27; its square = 729. Even-number or single-step shortcuts land on 625/784.

questions.text:
Find the value of following –
(0.11)² – (0.01)² / 1.2
questions.explanation: Use a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b): (0.11+0.01)(0.11−0.01) = 0.12×0.10 = 0.012; divide by 1.2 → 0.01. Decimal squaring errors produce 0.09/0.10 distractors.

questions.text:
From the following Histogram, what percent of decrease in production occurs from year 1976 to 1980?
(Production: 1976=3000, 1977=2500, 1978=2000, 1979=1000, 1980=500)
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Production falls from 3000 (1976) to 500 (1980)—drop of 2500 on base 3000 = 83.33%. Denominator must be initial value; using 2500 or final-only yields 75%/80% wrong bands. Distractors A (75%), C (80%), D (60.66%) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: If the side of square is increased by 25%, then its area will be increased by what percentage?
questions.explanation: Area scales with side²: 1.25² = 1.5625 → 56.25% increase, not the linear 25%. Halving the side increase or adding percentages linearly gives 25%/50% traps.

questions.text: The distance between Mumbai and Goa is 540 km. Two trains start running at the same time in the morning at 7.30 a.m. in opposite directions from these two stations with speed of 60 km/hr and 75 km/hr respectively. At what time will they cross each other?
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since Relative speed 60 + 75 = 135 km/h; meeting time 540/135 = 4 h from 7:30 am → 11:30 am. Using single train speed or wrong direction sum pushes noon/12:30 options. You can eliminate A (12.30 pm), B (12.00 noon), C (1.30 pm) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: A shopkeeper offers 25% discount on the printed price of a cupboard, yet he make 15% profit. If printed price of the cupboard is Rs. 23,000 then, what is the purchase price of it?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — Selling price after 25% discount: 0.75 × 23000 = 17250. With 15% profit on cost, CP = 17250/1.15 = 15000. Discount-on-discount or profit-on-MP mistakes give 16000/18000/20000. Distractors A (Rs. 16,000), B (Rs. 20,000), D (Rs. 18,000) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: Aadit walks northwards from his house. After a while, he turns to his right and a little further to his left. Finally, after walking a distance of one kilometer, he turns to his left again. In which direction is he moving now?
questions.explanation: Track turns: start North → right (East) → left (North) → left again (West). Final leg direction is West. Students stopping after three turns or mirroring left/right confuse East/North.

questions.text: The average age of Ram, Sham and John 5 years ago was 16 years. What will be their average age after 5 years?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because average age 5 years ago = 16 for three people → sum was 48. Present sum = 48 + 3×5 = 63 → present average 21. After 5 more years add another 15 → 78/3 = 26. Forgetting the second +5 yields 21/22. You can eliminate A (21 years), B (22 years), D (30 years) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:

questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Letter blocks grow: aa | bbba | aaaa | bbbb | aaaa | b — missing chunk is 'bbba' completing the bbba rhythm before the terminal b. 'baaa/bbbb' break the alternating aa/aaaa vs bb/bbbb structure. Distractors A (baaa), B (bbaa), C (bbbb) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text:

questions.explanation: Arithmetic progression in quarters: 3.75, 5.00 (+1.25), 6.25, 7.50, 8.75 → next 10.00. Each step adds 1.25; confusing this with a geometric ratio or wrong common difference gives 9.50 or 11.25.

questions.text: A student collects old data, compare it with new findings, identifies errors and proposes new conclusion. Which mental process does this represent?
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Comparing old data with new findings, spotting errors, and drawing a revised conclusion is evaluation/critical thinking—not mere observation, imitation, or rote memorisation. questions.text:

questions.text: If Spandan has read 3/6th part of a book of 120 pages, then how many pages of that book he did not read?
questions.explanation: Option B works here because 3/6 of 120 pages = 60 read → 120 − 60 = 60 unread (equivalently half the book). Using 3/6 as unread or wrong fraction of 120 gives 40/80 traps. questions.text: In a certain code language, 'THANKS' is written as 'SKNTHA'. How will you write, 'STUPID' in that code language?

questions.text: Rani and Suresh are a married couple have two daughters Medha and Deepti. Deepti is married to Anurag who is the son of Gareema and Tushar. Nidhi is the daughter of Anurag. questions.explanation: Deepti married Anurag (son of Garima–Tushar); Komal is Anurag's sister married to Harshit—so Deepti and Komal are sisters-in-law (brother's wife ↔ brother's wife's sister-in-law axis). Aunt/niece or blood-sister options ignore the marriage link through Anurag.

questions.text:
सन 1915 मध्ये म. गांधीजी भारतात आल्यानंतर पुढीलपैकी कोणते प्रश्न त्यांनी यशस्वीपणे हाताळले?

questions.explanation: पर्याय A ('अ', 'ब' आणि 'क') — स्वतंत्र मुस्लिम मतदारसंघ मॉन्टेग्यू–चेम्सफोर्ड (१९१९) संविधान सुधारणांतून आले — गांधीजींनी ते यशस्वी म्हणून हाताळले नाही। 'd' मिसळणारे पर्याय स्वातंत्र्यपूर्व काळातील प्रत्येक मुद्दा गांधीजींच्या खात्यात टाकणारे सापळे पर्याय B ('अ', 'क' आणि 'ड') या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C ('ब', 'ड' आणि 'अ') या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही; पर्याय D ('अ', 'ब', 'क' आणि 'ड') या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

questions.text:
3 सप्टेंबर 1942 रोजी तासगाव मामलेदार कचेरीवरील मोर्चाचे खालीलपैकी कोणत्या कार्यकर्त्यांनी नेतृत्व केले होते?
अ. कृष्णा रामा कुऱ्हाडे
ब. वि. स. पागे
क. गोविंद खोत
ड. डॉ. य. कृ. सोवनी

questions.text:
खालील वर्णनावरून समाज सुधारकाला ओळखा.
अ. त्यांनी 'ज्ञान प्रकाश' हे मराठी वृत्तपत्र काढले.
ब. सरकारने त्यांचा 'जस्टिस ऑफ पीस व राव बहादूर' या पदव्या देऊन गौरव केला.

questions.explanation: परीक्षेनुसार पर्याय D बरोबर आहे. प्रत्येक सूचना महाराष्ट्रातील सुधारक प्रोफाइलशी जुळवा: बाबा पद्मनजी (धर्मांतर/विधवा-पुनर्विवाह प्रेस), गोपाळ हरी देशमुख/लोकहितवादी (विधवा पुनर्विवाह, सामाजिक निबंध — पण 'ज्ञान प्रकाश' संपादक + राव बहादूर संगीत संरक्षण नाही), विष्णुशास्त्री पंडित (परंपरावादी). तीनही बिंदू एका नावाशी स्वच्छ बसत नाहीत — 'वरीलपैकी काहीही नाही' कीनुसार, ओळखीचे नाव जबरदस्ती लावू नका. चुकीचे पर्याय A (बाबा पद्मनजी), B (गोपाळ हरी देशमुख), C (विष्णुशास्त्री पंडित) हे या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पना किंवा व्याख्येशी जुळत नाहीत।

questions.text:
खालील विधाने वाचून कोणत्या स्त्री सुधारकाच्या कार्याची ओळख होते?

क. इ. स. 1894 साली त्यांनी 'हिंदु लेडिज सोशल क्लब' ची स्थापना केली.
ड. ठाकरसी, टाटा या कुटुंबियांनी त्यांच्या स्त्री उद्धाराच्या कार्याला आर्थिक पाठबळ दिले.
questions.explanation: पर्याय C हे योग्य निवड आहे. रमाबाई रानडे यांचे चरित्र प्रत्येक विधानाशी जुळते: शारदासदन आणि आर्य महिला समाज सह कार्य, कैसर-ए-हिंद पदक (१९१३), हिंदु लेडीज सोशल क्लब (१८९४) स्थापना, Thakursy/Tata आर्थिक पाठबळ. पंडिता रमाबाई (मुक्ती मिशन), रखमाबाई (विवाहवय प्रकरण), डॉ. आ Joshi (वैद्यक) — प्रत्येकजणी किमान एक चिन्ह गमावते।

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्रातील 1857 च्या उठावा संदर्भातील खालीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत?
अ. साताऱ्चे छत्रपती प्रतापसिंह यांचे गेलेले राज्य परत मिळविण्यासाठी रंगराव पागे यांनी अविरत प्रयत्न केले.
ब. कोल्हापूरात 31 जुलै 1857 रोजी 21 व्या व 28 व्या तुकडीतील शिपायांनी बंड केले.
