questions.text: Who among the following has inaugurated Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT)-Power Facility in New Delhi in September 2024?
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो। CSIRT-Power (वीज क्षेत्र सायबर सुरक्षा) September २०२४ Union मंत्री Manohar Lal यांनी उद्घाटन. संस्था, क्षेत्र आणि मंत्री उपस्थिती कीशी जुळते।

questions.text:
Find the correct statements about Pahalgam from the sentences given below.
(a) Pahalgam is situated in the District of Anantnag.
(b) Lidder Nallah attracts tourists in Pahalgam.
(c) It is an important transit camp on the way to Shri Mata Vaishno Devi.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो। Pahalgam Anantnag जिल्ह्यात (अ) आणि Lidder नदीवर पर्यटक केंद्र (ब) — दोन्ही बरोबर। Vaishno Devi यात्रा transit Katra (Reasi) केंद्रित; Pahalgam नाही — (क) चुकीचे पर्याय A ((a), (b), (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C ((a), (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D ((b), (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Which of the following about Article 243-G in the Constitution of India is/are correct?
(a) Disqualification of membership
(b) Powers, authority and responsibilities of Panchayats
(c) Composition of Panchayats
(d) Duration of Panchayats
questions.explanation: संविधानात हे लक्षात ठेवा — कलम २४३-ग हे पंचायती राजाचे अधिकार, शक्ती आणि जबाबदारी यांची तरतूद; सदस्यत्व किंवा कार्यकाळ नाही. अपात्रता कलम २४३-फ, रचना/आरक्षण कलम २४३-ड, कार्यकाळ कलम २४३-इ. जवळच्या कलमांची अदलाबदल हा सामान्य सापळा — पर्याय B पर्याय A (Only (a)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C ((a) and (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D ((c) and (d)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are correct?
(a) The office of the Advocate General for the State of Maharashtra came into existence with the formation of the State itself on May 1, 1960.
(b) The Advocate General shall be appointed in accordance with the provisions of Article 165 of the Constitution of India.
(c) Birendra Saraf is the Advocate General of Maharashtra. (as of August 2025)
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. महाराष्ट्राच्या महाधिवक्त्याबद्दलची सर्व विधाने खरी: पद १ मे १९६० पासून अस्तित्वात, कलम १६५वर आधारित, ऑगस्ट २०२५पर्यंत बिरेंद्र सराफ. एकटे विधान निवडण्याऐवजी तीनही एकत्र खरे — 'वरील सर्व' हा योग्य पर्याय पर्याय A ((a) and (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B ((b) and (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C ((a) and (b)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Which of the following is not fundamental duties?
(1) To strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavour and achievement.
(2) Who is parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or as the case may be ward between the age of six and fourteen years.
(3) Promote equal justice and free legal aid to the poor.
(4) To defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so.
questions.explanation: मूलभूत कर्तव्ये आणि मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे वेगळे ठेवा — मोफत कायदेशीर मदत आणि समान न्याय कलम ३९अ (मार्गदर्शक तत्त्व) अंतर्गत; मूलभूत कर्तव्य (५१अ) नाहीत। (1), (2), (4) ओळखलेली कर्तव्ये; पर्याय (D) कायदेशीर मदत चुकीचे जोडतो; (A) आणि (B) वैध कर्तव्ये वगळतात — पर्याय C पर्याय A ((1)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B ((2)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D ((4)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: Who among the following has served as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra for the longest period till September 2025?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे स्थिर — वसंतराव नाईक सप्टेंबर २०२५पर्यंत महाराष्ट्राचे सर्वात दीर्घकाळ मुख्यमंत्री: सुमारे अकरा वर्षे, तीन कार्यकाळ (१९६३–१९७५)। शरद पवार, देशमुख यांचा एकूण कालावधी लहान; अलीकडील मुख्यमंत्र्यांची ओळख सापळा — पर्याय D पर्याय A (Sharad Pawar) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Devendra Fadnavis) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Vasant Dada Patil) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: Which of the following is mentioned in Article-349?

options.A: Special procedure for the implementation of certain laws relating to language.
options.B: Language to be used in the Supreme Court and High Courts and for laws, bills etc.
options.C: Facilities for education in mother tongue at the primary level.
options.D: Directions for the development of Hindi language.

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. कलम ३४९ भाषा-संबंधित कायद्यांसाठी विशेष संसदीय प्रक्रिया — भाषा विधेयकांना विशेष समितीच्या अहवालानंतर राष्ट्रपतींची संमती. ३४३ (अधिकृत भाषा), ३५० (भाषिक अल्पसंख्य), ३५१ (हिंदी) नाही — 'विशेष प्रक्रिया'शी कलम जोडा पर्याय B (Language to be used in the Supreme Cour…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय C (Facilities for education in mother tong…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय D (Directions for the development of Hindi…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Match:
List-I (Item in the Indian Constitution) - List-II (Country from which it is derived)
(a) Directive Principles of State Policy - (i) Australia
(b) Fundamental Rights - (ii) Canada
(c) Concurrent list in Union State relations - (iii) Ireland
(d) India as a Union of States with greater powers to union - (iv) UK
(v) USA
questions.explanation: सरळ उत्तर — पर्याय D। संविधानाची उधारे मानक जोडी — मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे आयर्लंड, मूलभूत हक्क USA, समवर्ती यादी ऑस्ट्रेलिया, 'राज्यांच्या संघ'ातील मजबूत केंद्र कॅनडा. कोणतीही दोन स्रोत अदलाबदल — विशेषतः मूलभूत हक्क/USA आणि DPSP/आयर्लंड — पोलिटी नोट्समध्ये चुकीचे पर्याय A ((a)-(v), (b)-(iv), (c)-(i), (d)-(ii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय B ((a)-(iii), (b)-(v), (c)-(ii), (d)-(i)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय C ((a)-(v), (b)-(iv), (c)-(ii), (d)-(i)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी।

questions.text: Which of the following is mentioned in Article-8 of the Indian Constitution?

options.A: Rights of Citizenship of certain persons who have migrated to India from Pakistan.
options.B: Rights of Citizenship of certain persons of Indian origin residing outside India.
options.C: Rights of Citizenship of certain persons migrated to Pakistan.
options.D: Parliament to regulate the right of Citizenship by Law.

questions.explanation: नागरिकत्वाच्या तरतुदी — कलम ८ भारताबाहेर राहणाऱ्या भारतीय मूळ व्यक्तींचे नागरिकत्व (PIO)। ५–७ प्रारंभिक नागरिकत्व; ९ परकीय नागरिकत्व स्वीकार. ८ = परदेशात राहणारे, जन्माच्या देशातील नागरिकत्व नाही — पर्याय B पर्याय A (Rights of Citizenship of certain person…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय C (Rights of Citizenship of certain person…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय D (Parliament to regulate the right of Cit…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे।

questions.text:
Select the incorrect statement/s about qualification of Vice-President.
(a) is a citizen of India.
(b) has completed the age of forty five years.
(c) is qualified for election as a member of House of People (Lok Sabha).
questions.explanation: सरळ उत्तर — पर्याय A। उपराष्ट्रपती किमान ३५ वर्ष आणि राज्यसभेसाठी निवडण्यास पात्र — ४५ नाही, लोकसभेचे सदस्य नाही। (b) आणि (c) चुकी; (a) आणि (d) बरोबर। (c) किंवा (d) चुकीचे म्हणणारे पर्याय उलट आहेत पर्याय B (Only (b)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (Only (a), (c)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (All of the above) प्रत्येक विधान बरोबर म्हणतो, पण यापैकी किमान एक विधान चुकीचे आहे।

questions.text:
Select the correct statements about Role of Prime Minister:
(a) Ramsay Muir - "Prime Minister is the steersman of steering wheel of the ship of the state."
(b) H.R.G. Greaves - "The Government is the master of the country and Prime Minister is the master of Government."
(c) Munro - "Prime Minister is a moon among lesser stars."
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. पंतप्रधानाच्या भूमिकेवरील उद्धरणे — म्युअरचे 'मंत्रिमंडळाच्या मुख्याशी' आणि ग्रीव्ह्जचे 'सरकाराचे स्वामी' (a), (b) बरोबर. मुन्रोचे 'लहान तारांमधील चंद्र' या कीमध्ये PM उद्धरण म्हणून मोजले नाही — 'सर्व तीन' आपोआप निवडू नका पर्याय B (Only (b), (c)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (Only (a), (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (All of the above) प्रत्येक विधान बरोबर म्हणतो, पण यापैकी किमान एक विधान चुकीचे आहे।

questions.text:
In 1950, the Constitution of India contained a four-fold classification of units of the Indian Union.
(a) Part A - Princely states with legislature
(b) Part B - Governor's provinces of British India
(c) Part C - Chief Commissioner's provinces of British India
(d) Part D - Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Select the correct pairs from the above:
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. १९३५ च्या भारत सरकार कायद्यात भाग C = Chief Commissioner's provinces; भाग D = अंदमान-निकोबार. भाग A/B चुकीचे जोडते — फक्त पर्याय (B) भाग C आणि D बरोबर जोडतो पर्याय A (Only (a), (b), (c)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (Only (b), (d), (a)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (All of the above) प्रत्येक विधान बरोबर म्हणतो, पण यापैकी किमान एक विधान चुकीचे आहे।

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are false in concern with the Governor?
(a) As per Article 158 the Governor shall hold office during the pleasure of the President.
(b) As per Article 155 the Governor of a state shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.
(c) As per Article 154 the executive power of the state shall be vested in the Governor and shall be exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with this Constitution.
(d) As per Article 163 there shall be a council of ministers with the Chief Minister at the head to aid and advise the Governor.
questions.explanation: सरळ उत्तर — पर्याय A। राज्यपाल काढण्यासाठी 'राष्ट्रपतींच्या समाधानावर' — कलम १५६; १५८ नाही — हे एकमेव चुकीचे विधान. १५४ (कार्यकारी), १५५ (नियुक्ती), १५७ (अर्हता) (b)(c)(d) बरोबर; एकच कलम अदलाबदल पर्याय B (Only (b)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C ((b) and (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D ((c) and (d)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Match the following:
List-I (Subject) - List-II (Article No.)
(a) Gram Sabha - (i) 243 K
(b) Reservation of seats - (ii) 243 F
(c) Elections to the Panchayats - (iii) 243 A
(d) Disqualification for membership - (iv) 243 D
questions.explanation: पंचायत राज कलमांचा संच लक्षात ठेवा — ग्रामसभा २४३-अ, आरक्षण २४३-ड, निवडणूक २४३-क, अपात्रता २४३-फ. विसंवादी पर्याय दोन क्रमांक अदलाबदल करतात — चारही एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय A पर्याय B ((a)-(iii), (b)-(ii), (c)-(i), (d)-(iv)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय C ((a)-(iv), (b)-(iii), (c)-(ii), (d)-(i)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय D ((a)-(iv), (b)-(i), (c)-(ii), (d)-(iii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी।

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are related to Article 20 of the Constitution of India?
(a) No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
(b) No person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once.
(c) No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.
(d) The state shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. कलम २० दुहेरी शिक्षा आणि स्व-अपराधीकरणापासून संरक्षण — दोन वेगळे फौजदारी ढाल. २१ = जीवन/वैयक्तिक स्वातंत्र्य; २१अ = प्राथमिक शिक्षण. पर्याय (B) एकटा दोन्ही कलम २० हक्क जोडतो पर्याय A (Only (a), (b), (c)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (Only (a), (d)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (All of the above) प्रत्येक विधान बरोबर म्हणतो, पण यापैकी किमान एक विधान चुकीचे आहे।

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are not included in Article 168?
(a) For every state there shall be a legislature which shall consist of the Governor.
(b) Where there are two Houses of the Legislature of a state, one shall be known as the Legislative Council and other as the Legislative Assembly.
(c) Where there is only one house, it shall be known as the Legislative Assembly.
(d) The Legislative Assembly of each state shall consist of not more than five hundred and not less than sixty members chosen by direct election from territorial constituencies in the state.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. कलम १६८ राज्य विधानमंडळ स्थापन करते; MLA संख्या मर्यादा (कमाल ५००, किमान ६०) कलम १७० मध्ये, १६८ मध्ये नाही। (a)(b)(c) १६८ बाबत बरोबर; पर्याय (B) फक्त चुकीची संख्या-तरतूद दर्शवतो पर्याय A ((a)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C ((b) and (c)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D ((a) and (b)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: Which of the following articles and parts of the Indian Constitution enumerate fundamental duties?
questions.explanation: सरळ उत्तर — पर्याय A। मूलभूत कर्तव्ये कलम ५१अ, भाग IVA — ४२ वी दुरुस्ती. मूलभूत हक्क (III), मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे (IV) नाहीत; १९५० मूळ मजकुरात नव्हते। 'भाग IVA + ५१अ' ही परीक्षेत अपेक्षित जोडी पर्याय B (Article 55 A, Part III A) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Article 41 A, Part IV C) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Article 46 A, Part III B) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
State whether following statements are true or false:
(a) X-rays are electromagnetic waves.
(b) The wavelength of X-ray is very short.
(c) X-rays are having negative charge.
(d) X-rays are deflected by electric and magnetic fields.
questions.explanation: विज्ञानात हे स्थिर — X-किरणे विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग, अतिशय लहान तरंगलांबी — (a)(b) खरे. निव्वळ विद्युभार नसल्याने विद्युत/चुंबकीय क्षेत्रात वाकत नाहीत — (c)(d) खोटे। T,T,F,F → पर्याय (A) पर्याय B ((a) False, (b) False, (c) True, (d) Fal…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय C ((a) True, (b) False, (c) True, (d) False) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय D ((a) True, (b) True, (c) True, (d) False) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे।

questions.text:
Match the pairs.
(a) Alpha particle - (i) Curie
(b) Beta particle - (ii) Electron
(c) Unit of Radioactivity - (iii) ₂He⁴-Helium atom
(d) Gamma rays - (iv) Photon of high energy
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. अल्फा विकिरण = हिलियम कण (२ प्रोटॉन + २ न्यूट्रॉन); बीटा = इलेक्ट्रॉन; क्युरी = विकिरणाचे माप; गामा = उच्च-ऊर्जा विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग. कण-फोटॉन गोंधळणारे पर्याय टाळा — (D) चारही जोड्या बरोबर पर्याय A ((a)-(i), (b)-(ii), (c)-(iii), (d)-(iv)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय B ((a)-(i), (b)-(iv), (c)-(ii), (d)-(iii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय C ((a)-(iii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(ii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी।

questions.text: Latent heat of fusion is defined as _________.

options.A: the amount of heat required to heat unit mass of the substance.
options.B: the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a unit mass through 1°C.
options.C: the amount of heat required to convert unit mass of the substance from solid to liquid at its melting point without rise of temperature.

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. गोठवण्याची अदृश्य उष्णता म्हणजे गोठणबिंदूवर एक एकक द्रव्याचे घन ते द्रव होण्यासाठी लागणारी ऊर्जा, तापमान न बदलता — टप्पा-बदलाची ऊर्जा. वाष्पीकरण, उर्ध्वपातन किंवा 'घन गरम करणे' वेगळ्या प्रक्रिया पर्याय A (the amount of heat required to heat uni…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय B (the amount of heat required to raise th…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय D (None of the above) योग्य जोडी/विधान नाकारतो, पण प्रश्नाच्या तथ्यांनुसार बरोबर उत्तर अस्तित्वात आहे।

questions.text: Which of the following is correct order of atmospheric layers from ground to upwards?
questions.explanation: भूगोलात हे स्थिर — जमिनीपासून वरची थर: क्षोभमंडल → समतापमंडल → मध्यमंडल → तापमंडल. आयनमंडल वरच्या थरांशी अतिव्याप; क्षोभमंडलानंतर समतापमंडल येतो, समताप-मध्य उलट करणे सापळा — पर्याय D पर्याय A (Stratosphere → Mesosphere → Thermospher…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Mesosphere → Thermosphere → Troposphere…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Thermosphere → Troposphere → Stratosphe…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: Which is the Principle ore of Aluminium?
questions.explanation: सरळ उत्तर — पर्याय A। बॉक्साइट हा अॅल्युमिनियमाचा मुख्य वाणिज्यिक अयस्क — हायड्रेटेड अॅल्युमिनियम ऑक्साइड. मॅलाकाइट तांब्याचे, गॅलेना सीसाचे, डोलोमाइट साधारण खडक — प्राथमिक Al स्रोत नाहीत पर्याय B (Malachite) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Galina) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Dolamite) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: What is the atomic mass number of most abundant isotope of carbon?
questions.explanation: रसायनशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — कार्बन-१२ (^12C) नैसर्गिक कार्बनात सुमारे ९८.९% — स्थिर, सम प्रोटॉन-न्यूट्रॉन. कार्बन-१३ व १४ अल्प; १४ हा रेडिओधर्मी, दुर्मिळ — पर्याय D पर्याय A (6) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर D (12) आहे; पर्याय B (14) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर D (12) आहे; पर्याय C (13) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर D (12) आहे।

questions.text: The Dentalium belongs Phylum:
questions.explanation: विज्ञानात हे स्थिर — पर्याय A बरोबर आहे. जीवशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Dentalium (दंतकवच/टस्क शेल) Scaphopoda वर्ग, संघ Mollusca — शं, समुद्रात खोदणारा। Echinodermata, Annelida, Arthropoda नाही — 'tusk shell → Mollusca' मानक — पर्याय A।

questions.text: Many species of catfish have taste buds on whisker like projections, which help in finding food are called as:
questions.explanation: विज्ञानात हे स्थिर — पर्याय B बरोबर आहे. जीवशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Barbels म्हणजे मांजर मासळीवरील मिश्या-सारखे संवेदी अवयव; ग पाणyात चवीच्या कलिकांनी अन्न शोधण्यासाठी. पंख, ग cover (operculum), lateral शाखा वेगळी कामे — प्रश्नातील 'whiskers' = barbels — पर्याय B।

questions.text: Which of the following animal belongs to the group Agnatha, the most primitive vertebrates?
questions.explanation: Petromyzon (lamprey) belongs to Class Agnatha—jawless, cartilaginous fish with a sucking mouth, no paired fins. Treating it as a bony fish (Osteichthyes) or a gnathostome misses the jawless branch of vertebrate classification पर्याय A (Scoliodon (Dog fish)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Rattus rattus (Black rat)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Loris) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Match the correct example of the Plant group.
Plant Group - Example
(a) Algae - (i) Cycas
(b) Bryophyte - (ii) Lycopodium
(c) Pteridophyte - (iii) Funaria
(d) Gymnosperm - (iv) Chlamydomonas
questions.explanation: The plant-kingdom pairs are पाठ्यपुस्तक: Chlamydomonas (algae), Funaria (bryophyte moss), Lycopodium (pteridophyte club moss), Cycas (gymnosperm)। Any option swapping Funaria with a fern ally or Cycas with an alga breaks the progression from simple algae to naked-seed plants पर्याय A ((a)-(i), (b)-(ii), (c)-(iii), (d)-(iv)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय B ((a)-(ii), (b)-(iv), (c)-(i), (d)-(iii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय D ((a)-(iii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iv), (d)-(ii)) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी।

questions.text: What symptoms of phosphorus deficiency is characterised by stunted growth of the entire plant, dark green colouration at the leaves which may be malformed and contains small areas of dead tissues is called as?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (Necrotic spots) — Phosphorus deficiency in plants shows stunted growth, dark green foliage, and necrotic/dead patches on leaves—classic P-starvation morphology. Nitrogen lack tends toward general chlorosis; potassium toward marginal scorch; sulphur toward uniform yellowing—different signatures पर्याय A (Chlorosis) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (Wilting) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Leaf curling) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: Which mineral plays important role in calcium metabolism of plants?
questions.explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास पर्याय D योग्य ठरतो। Fe carrier, N fixer, K substitute नाही — micronutrient यादीत अंदाजाने नको MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: _________ vitamin helps in blood clotting.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे। Vitamin K clotting factors II, VII, IX, X synthesis — । Vitamins A, D, E govern vision, calcium absorption, antioxidant roles — coagulation cascade नाहीत। K ।

questions.text: ABO blood group was discovered by _________.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. इतर नावे immunology/genetics, या landmark कामाशी नाहीत उत्तर निश्चित करताना प्रश्नातील मुख्य संकल्पना आणि वर्ष लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: World Diabetes Day is celebrated on _________.
questions.explanation: आरोग्य दिन — World Diabetes Day 14 November — WHO/IDF, । October, January, March इतर आरोग्य दिन — पर्याय D विषय-पॅकमध्ये हा बिंदू पुन्हा विचारला जाऊ शकतो, म्हणून मुख्य तथ्य एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: The sum of the first 15 terms of the series 1/(2×3) + 1/(3×4) + 1/(4×5) + ......... is:
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. गणितात हा शॉर्टकट — पर्याय A (15/34)। Σ 1/[n(n+1)] n=2–16 telescopes: 1/[n(n+1)] = 1/n − 1/(n+1) → sum 1/2 − 1/17 = 15/34. अर्धवट-अपूर्णांक — 14/17 उलट गुणोत्तर सापळा पर्याय।

questions.text: The sum of six consecutive even numbers A, B, C, D, E, F is 150. What is the sum of the next three consecutive even numbers?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. ६ सम संख्या बेरीज 150 → mean 25 → 20,22,24,26,28,30; पुढील 32,34,36 बेरीज 102. सरासरी shortcut पर्याय A (90) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (102) आहे; पर्याय B (100) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (102) आहे; पर्याय D (80) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (102) आहे।

questions.text: An empty pool being filled with water at a constant rate takes 8 hours to fill 3/5 of its capacity. How much more time will it take to fill the pool completely?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो। 3/5 काम 8 तास → संपूर्ण 40/3 तास; उरलेले 2/5 = 16/3 = 5 तास 20 मिनिट. पूर्ण भागापासून scale पर्याय A (5 hrs 30 min) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (13 hrs 20 min) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (6 hrs 20 min) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: In measuring the sides of a rectangle, there is an increase of 5% on one side and 10% decrease on the other side. Then the absolute error percentage in the calculation of area of the rectangle is _________.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. क्षेत्रफळात (1+5%)×(1−10%)=0.945 → 5.5% खाली; 5%−10%=−5% linear add चuकी — errors multiplicatively पर्याय A (5.1%) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर B (5.5%) आहे; पर्याय C (7.5%) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर B (5.5%) आहे; पर्याय D (10%) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर B (5.5%) आहे।

questions.text: The curved surface of a cylindrical pillar is 352 m² and its volume is 2464 m³. What is the height of the pillar?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय A आहे। Curved surface 2πrh = 352, volume πr²h = 2464. Volume ÷ CSA = r/2 = 7 → r = 14; then h = 4. CSA-to-volume गुणोत्तर एकाच step मध्ये π cancel — ।

questions.text: A company manufactures electronic equipment. While deciding price of that equipment, the company includes 10% profit for itself, 20% profit for wholesaler and 30% profit for retailer. By how much percent is the decided price more than manufacturing cost of that equipment?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो। 1.10×1.20×1.30=1.716 → 71.6% वर — 10+20+30=60% चuकी। Markups multiplicatively पर्याय A (60) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (71.6) आहे; पर्याय B (70.6) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (71.6) आहे; पर्याय D (75) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (71.6) आहे।

questions.text: In a country the ratio of number of states to number of union territories is 52 : 13. By how much percentage is the number of states more than the number of union territories in that country?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो। 52 राज्य + 13 UT = 65; excess 39 → 39/65×100=60%। 'Difference as % of total parts' — फक्त UTs base 300% चuकी पर्याय A (20) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (60) आहे; पर्याय B (40) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (60) आहे; पर्याय D (80) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (60) आहे।

questions.text: Mobile users percentage increased from 43% to 65% in the year 2024. What is the percentage increase relative to 43%?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो। 43 ते 65 relative increase: (65−43)/43×100≈51.16%। Base 65 किंवा चuकी वजाबाकी 75%/34% चुकीचे पर्याय पर्याय A (22.12) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (51.16) आहे; पर्याय B (45.27) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (51.16) आहे; पर्याय D (80.30) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर C (51.16) आहे।

questions.text: The amount of work done by 3 men is same as that done by 5 boys. Similarly, the amount of work done by 5 women is equal to that done by 8 boys. If 12 men and 14 boys require 24 days to finish the work, then how many days will be needed for 9 men, 15 women and 12 boys to complete the work?
questions.explanation: From 3M = 5B and 5W = 8B, convert every worker to boy-equivalents. The given crew's 24-day finish fixes total work; scaling to 9M + 15W + 12B yields 16 days—option (A)। Keep one unit system throughout; mixing unconverted rates double-counts capacity पर्याय B (18) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (16) आहे; पर्याय C (20) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (16) आहे; पर्याय D (26) मध्ये चुकीची संख्या/टक्केवारी दिली आहे; योग्य उत्तर A (16) आहे।

questions.text: The average price of 10 books is ₹ 16 while the average price of eight books is ₹ 9.5, of the remaining two books. If the price of one book is 40% more than the price of the other. What is the price of each of these two books?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो। 10×16=160; 8×9.5=76; दoही बeरीज 84; x+1.4x=84 → 35,49. '40% more' = 1:1.4 ratio पर्याय B (₹ 40 and 24) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (₹ 25 and 12) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (₹ 30 and 18) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: How many numbers from 1 to 100 are there each of which is exactly divisible by 4 and also has '4' as digit in it?

questions.text: The book, 'Jatibhed Viveksar' was written by _________.
questions.explanation: 'Jatibhed Viveksar' is a caste-critique tract associated with Tukaram Tatya Padval, a lesser-known but exam-relevant Maharashtra reform writer—not Jyotiba Phule (Sarvajanik Satyagraha, Gulamgiri), Vitthal Ramji Shinde (depressed-classes uplift), or Bhaurao Patil (Rayat Shikshan). questions.text:
Who were the Prime Ministers of India and China while accepting the Panchashil Principles?
A. Pandit Nehru and Zhou Enlaay
B. Pandit Nehru and Dr. San-Yat-Sen
C. Indira Gandhi and Mao-Tse-Tung
D. Pandit Nehru and Mao-Tse-Tung
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Panchashila was formally affirmed in the 1954 India–China Agreement on Tibet, signed when Jawaharlal Nehru was PM of India and Zhou Enlai was Premier of China. Sun Yat-sen belonged to an earlier Republican era; Mao was China's paramount leader but not the premier at the signing; Indira Gandhi became PM only in 1966. Only pair A (Nehru–Zhou Enlai) fits the 1950s diplomatic timeline. You can eliminate A (A and B), B (C and A), C (C and D) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: The book 'Vidhava Vapan Anachar' was written by _________.
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because Vyankatesh Rango Katti authored 'Vidhava Vapan Anachar', attacking the custom of widow immolation/remarriage taboos in orthodox society. Vishnushastri Pandit wrote polemics defending tradition; Jambhekar pioneered Marathi journalism; Agarkar campaigned on education and social reform through Kesari/Marathi press—but not this widow-remarriage tract title. questions.text: On 11th April 1942, a resolution was passed by the Congress Working Committee rejecting _________.
questions.explanation: On 11 April 1942 the Congress Working Committee met at Allahabad and formally rejected the Cripps Mission offer as inadequate for Indian self-rule—just before Quit India intensified. Aligarh Scheme, Curzon Plan, and Latif's Scheme belong to different constitutional or communal-reform contexts, not the April 1942 CWC resolution.

questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since the Indian Councils Act, 1909 implemented the Morley–Minto Reforms: separate electorates for Muslims and expanded Indian participation to placate moderates and the Muslim League. questions.text: "Reformers have to face opposition from our near and dear ones – parents, wives, daughters and countrymen with whom we have to travel through life." This was said by the social reformer Wamanrao Madhavrao Kolhatkar, who hailed from _________.

questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because in Mughal fiqh-based justice: Hadd covers fixed Quranic penalties (death, amputation); Tazir covers discretionary punishments like warning or banishment; Qisas is retributive 'tit-for-tat'; Tashir exposes the offender to public disgrace. questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a renewable energy resource?

questions.text: The term sustainable development first came into prominence in the World Conservation Strategy presented in _________.
questions.explanation: The term 'sustainable development' gained global policy prominence in the IUCN–UNEP–WWF 'World Conservation Strategy' (1980). The Brundtland Report (1987) popularised the definition later; Rio (1992) was the Earth Summit—different milestones on the same concept arc.

questions.text: What is India's position in the Sustainable Development Goals Index released in 2020?

questions.text: "Economic growth is the increase in output only" whose statement was this?
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Charles P. Kindleberger articulated a narrow 'growth as output increase' view in development economics discourse—contrasting broader welfare definitions. questions.text:
Consider the following statements and choose the correct option regarding Indian economy.
A. Considering the economic changes in India after globalisation, 'Trickle Down Theory' is precisely applicable to Indian economy.
B. The high growth rate of Indian economy after globalisation, especially since 2005, poses question about applicability of the 'Trickle Down Theory'.

questions.text: "About 40% of the population of the developing world did not benefit from economic growth during the 1950's and 1960's." Who made this statement?

questions.text:

questions.text: The ratio of lengths to radii of two rods of same material is 1 : 2 and 2 : 3. If temperature difference between two ends of the rod is same, then what will be the ratio of heat flow?
questions.explanation: For steady conduction in the same material, heat flow Q = kAΔT/L with k and ΔT identical for both rods, so Q ∝ r²/L. Given L₁:L₂ = 1:2 and r₁:r₂ = 2:3, Q₁/Q₂ = (r₁/r₂)² × (L₂/L₁) = (4/9) × (2/1) = 8/9. Options like 3:2 or 4:3 forget the inverse length factor or square only one radius.

questions.text: Neutrino particle is emitted in the process of _________.
questions.explanation: Β-decay converts a neutron to a proton with emission of an electron and an antineutrino (Pauli postulated the neutrino to balance energy–momentum). α-decay ejects a helium nucleus; γ-decay is electromagnetic with no neutrino; X-rays are not a nuclear decay channel.

questions.text: What is the effect of increase in temperature on viscosity of gases?
questions.explanation: Unlike liquids, gas viscosity rises with temperature because faster molecules transfer more momentum across layers during collisions. questions.text: Citrus canker is caused by which type of pathogen?
questions.explanation: Citrus canker is a bacterial disease caused by Xanthomonas citri (formerly X. axonopodis pv. citri)—raised lesions on leaves, twigs and fruit. Fungal rots, viral mosaic and nematode galls produce different symptom patterns on citrus.

questions.text: Which of the following sets of hormones regulate menstrual cycle?

questions.text:
Which of the following Social Work Organizations were established through Prarthana Samaj?
(a) Social Service League - N.M. Joshi
(b) Servants of India Society - G.K. Gokhale
(c) Arya Samaj - Dayanand Saraswati
(d) Depressed Classes Mission - V.R. Shinde
questions.explanation: Prarthana Samaj (1867, Mumbai) seeded several reform bodies: G.K. Gokhale's Servants of India Society (1905), N.M. Joshi's Social Service League, and V.R. Shinde's Depressed Classes Mission all trace to that milieu. Arya Samaj was Dayanand Saraswati's separate north-Indian revival movement—not a Prarthana Samaj offshoot. Options mixing in (c) trap students who lump every 19th-century samaj under one banner.

questions.text: Which Act was described by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru as 'a new charter of Slavery'?
questions.explanation: The answer is option C: Jawaharlal Nehru attacked the Government of India Act, 1935 as a 'new charter of slavery' because it entrenched colonial control—provincial autonomy on paper, but veto power, princely-state safeguards, and no real self-rule. Morley–Minto (1909) and Montagu–Chelmsford (1919) drew other epithets; Rowlatt (1919) was the 'black' repressive law—not Nehru's 1935 phrase. You can eliminate A (The Morley-Minto Reforms Act, 1909), B (The Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms Act, 1919), D (Rowlatt Act, 1919) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which of the following cities did company Government provide the arrangement of training for its soldiers to handle 'Enfield Rifle'?
(a) Ambala (b) Calcutta (c) Sialkot (d) Dum Dum
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because the greased Enfield cartridges of 1857 were issued at company arsenals where sepoys trained on the new rifle—Ambala, Sialkot, and Dum Dum are the standard trio in Maharashtra history syllabi. Calcutta (Fort William) was the political capital, not one of the three named rifle-training centres in most textbook lists. Partial sets dropping Dum Dum or Sialkot miss the complete deployment chain. Distractors A ((a), (b) and (c)), B ((b) and (d)), D ((a), (b) and (d)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: The District Local Board was established during the period of which Viceroy?
questions.explanation: Lord Ripon (1880–84) is the 'Father of Local Self-Government' in India; his 1882 resolution expanded district and municipal boards, including District Local Boards for rural administration. Lytton rolled back Ripon's liberalism; Curzon centralised; Wellesley predates the Ripon-era local-board framework.

questions.text: 'Famine Code' was prepared in 1883 on the recommendation of which of the following Commissions?
questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since the Indian Famine Code of 1883 flowed directly from the recommendations of the Famine Commission headed by Sir Richard Strachey (1880)—standardising relief, works, and mortality reporting after recurring droughts. George Campbell and James Lyall chaired later famine inquiries; MacDonald belongs to a different policy era. Strachey + 1883 Famine Code is the pair to lock. You can eliminate B (George Campbell Commission), C (MacDonald Commission), D (Sir James Lyall Commission) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Who of the following was not associated with art of 'Satyashodhak Jalsa'?
questions.explanation: Satyashodhak Jalsa was the cultural-theatre wing of Jotirao Phule's Satyashodhak Samaj—Bhaurao Patole, Ramchandra Ghatge, and Jotirao Falke are documented performers/organisers. Honaji Bala belongs to the Tamasha/folk-theatre tradition, not the Satyashodhak Jalsa circuit. 'Not associated' points to the name outside Phule's reform stage.

questions.text:
Identify the person by reading the following statements.
Statement A: Praised as 'An Ambassador of Hindu-Muslim Unity' by Sarojini Naidu.
Statement B: He made this statement in his speech in the legislature, 'I am a Nationalist First, a Nationalist later and a Nationalist last'.
questions.explanation: Sarojini Naidu famously hailed the early Jinnah as an 'ambassador of Hindu–Muslim unity' before the communal turn. His legislature speech—'I am a Nationalist first, a Nationalist second, and a Nationalist last'—is quoted in standard biographies of the pre-1940 Jinnah. Azad, Iqbal, and Sir Syed each miss one of the two stem markers.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) 1899 'Gurakhi' (Mumbai) - (i) A.B. Kolhatkar
(b) 1906 'Bhala' (Pune) - (ii) Gir
(c) 1907 'Hari Kishore' (Yavatmal) - (iii) Shri L.N. Joshi
(d) 1909 'Deshsevak' (Nagpur) - (iv) Bhopatkar
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because anchor the editors to dates and places: 1899 'Gurakhi' (Mumbai) → Shri L.N. Joshi; 1906 'Bhala' (Pune) → Bhopatkar; 1907 'Hari Kishore' (Yavatmal) → Gir; 1909 'Deshsevak' (Nagpur) → A.B. Kolhatkar. That yields a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i. Swapping Kolhatkar with Bhopatkar or Gir breaks the chronology of Marathi nationalist journalism. You can eliminate A (a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i), B (a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii), D (a-ii, b-iii, c-i, d-iv) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: What was the Strachey Commission about?
questions.explanation: The answer is option C: the Strachey Commission (1880) was appointed to frame famine/drought relief policy after the Great Famine of 1876–78—not education, health, or child-marriage reform. Its report underpinned the 1883 Famine Code. Students who recall 'Strachey' only from Q5 should connect both questions to the same drought-relief mandate. Distractors A (Educational Reforms), B (Health Improvement), D (Prevention of Child Marriage) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Who among the following was the first president of the 'All India Trade Union Congress' established in 1920?
questions.explanation: Lala Lajpat Rai presided over the inaugural session of the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) at Bombay in 1920. Tilak died that year and was never AITUC president; Shripad Dange and Ashok Mehta led the body in later decades. First-president MCQs almost always test the 1920 founding chair, not later communist or socialist heads.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The latitudinal extension of Maharashtra is less than the longitudinal extension.
(b) The Tropic of Cancer Passes through Maharashtra.
(c) The east-west length of Maharashtra is about 800 k.m.
(d) The area of Maharashtra is 3,07,713 sq. k.m.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra runs roughly 720 km north–south (latitudinal span) versus ~800 km east–west (longitudinal span)—so (a) holds. The Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Tripura, not Maharashtra—(b) is incorrect. Official area 3,07,713 sq km and ~800 km east–west width make (c) and (d) correct; only (a), (c), and (d) survive.

questions.text:
Arrange the following mountain peaks in descending order of height.
(a) Makalu (b) Nandadevi (c) Annapurna (d) Badarinath
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Height order among the four: Makalu (~8,485 m) tops Annapurna I (~8,091 m), then Nandadevi (~7,816 m), with Badrinath (~6,150 m) far lower—it is a pilgrimage peak, not an 8,000-er. Descending sequence is (a)–(c)–(b)–(d). Options placing Nandadevi above Makalu or Badrinath mid-list confuse Himalayan hierarchy. Distractors A ((d), (a), (b), (c)), B ((b), (d), (c), (a)), D ((c), (b), (a), (d)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: India has the longest border with which of the following country?
questions.explanation: India's longest international land border is with Bangladesh (~4,096 km)—longer than China, Pakistan, Nepal, or Myanmar segments. Nepal and Bhutan borders are substantial but shorter; Pakistan ranks third among neighbours by length. 'Longest border' prelims almost always expect Bangladesh, not the more politically salient Pakistan line.

questions.text: Which of the following script is used in Santhali language?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Santhali (Munda family) is written in Ol Chiki, invented by Pandit Raghunath Murmu in 1925 and later included in the Eighth Schedule. 'Billu' and 'Kota' are distractor script names; Braille is a tactile system for the visually impaired, not a Santhali language script. Distractors A (Billu), C (Brail), D (Kota) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. (b) Nandurbar - (ii) City of Lakes

(b) Maharashtra Agricultural Commissioner Office is at Mukundnagar, Pune.

questions.text:
According to the Maharashtra Co-operative Act, 1960 which of the following is/are not the purpose of audit of Co-operative societies?
(a) To check whether all the books of account are maintained by the Co-operative societies registered under the Co-operative societies Act.
(b) To check whether the management of Co-operative societies is in accordance with the Co-operative Act and the principles of Co-operation.
(c) In case of mal practices in the Co-operative society, making the directors liable and imposing financial penalties.
(d) To detect errors and irregular transactions in the accumulated expenditure of Co-operative societies.
questions.explanation: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act audit aims at verifying accounts, statutory compliance, and detecting irregularities—not adjudicating malpractices or imposing penalties on directors (that is prosecution/ registrar action). Statement (c) alone falls outside audit's defined purpose; (a), (b), and (d) describe legitimate audit objectives.

questions.text: As per the Economic survey of Maharashtra 2023-24 _________ is the largest contributor of own tax revenue of the state.
questions.explanation: Maharashtra Economic Survey 2023–24 identifies GST as the largest single component of the state's own tax revenue—reflecting post-2017 subsumed indirect taxes. State VAT on sales/trade now sits inside GST; standalone 'Tax on Sales' or 'Tax on Social Services' no longer tops the own-revenue table.

(a) Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI) - (i) 1964

CHCl₃ retains three polar C–Cl bonds without full cancellation, giving the largest non-zero dipole in the set. CHI₃ is polar too, but syllabus keys and textbook comparisons for this exact quartet point to chloroform (CHCl₃) as the standout asymmetric halomethane.

questions.text:
Match the below mentioned animal with their order:
(a) Indian earthworm - (i) Hemiptera
(b) Indian Cattle leech - (ii) Opisthopora
(c) Honey bee - (iii) Gnathobdellida
(d) Bedbug - (iv) Hymenoptera
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Taxonomic orders: Indian earthworm (Pheretima) → Opisthopora (ii); Indian cattle leech → Gnathobdellida (iii); honey bee → Hymenoptera (iv); bedbug → Hemiptera (i). Pairing earthworm with Hemiptera or bee with Gnathobdellida scrambles invertebrate classification—one correct match (bee–Hymenoptera) prunes most grids. Distractors A (a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii), B (a-ii, b-iii, c-i, d-iv), C (a-iii, b-i, c-ii, d-iv) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: In Peteromyzon, the anticoagulant is secreted by _________.
questions.explanation: In Petromyzon (lamprey), the salivary gland secretes anticoagulant (hirudin-like) so host blood flows during ectoparasitic feeding. Goblet and mucous glands produce lubrication; zymogen cells relate to digestive enzyme precursors—not the anticoagulant role tested here.

questions.text: "Kangaroo" is an animal belongs to Phylum _________.
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Kangaroo is a marsupial mammal (class Mammalia, infraclass Marsupialia)—hair, mammary glands, and pouch-rearing place it firmly outside Reptilia, Amphibia, and Aves. 'Phylum' in the stem is loose exam wording; the correct answer is Mammalia among the class-level options offered. You can eliminate A (Reptilia), C (Amphibia), D (Aves) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Biofertilizers bring about:

options.A: addition of Mercury to the Soil.
options.C: increase in the Acidity of Soil.

questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Biofertilizers (Rhizobium, Azotobacter, mycorrhiza, etc.) fix or mobilise nutrients—enriching soil fertility without chemical overload. They do not add toxic mercury, deliberately acidify soil, or deplete fertility—options (a), (c), and (d) describe harms opposite to sustainable agriculture extension messages. Distractors A (addition of Mercury to the Soil.), C (increase in the Acidity of Soil.), D (decrease in soil fertility.) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Tikka disease of Groundnut is caused by:
questions.explanation: Groundnut tikka (early leaf spot) is a fungal leaf-blight caused by Cercospora arachidicola / C. personata—not rust (Puccinia), anthracnose (Colletotrichum on other crops), or Fusarium wilt complexes. Pathogen-class mismatch is how MPSC splits look-alike crop-disease names.

questions.text: Which of the following statement is incorrect about bryophytes?

options.A: They are known as amphibians of Plant kingdom.
options.C: They have rhizoids instead of roots.

questions.explanation: Option D works here because Bryophytes (mosses, liverworts) are 'amphibians of the plant kingdom'—need water for fertilisation and have rhizoids instead of true roots; all true. Rhizopus is a zygomycete fungus (bread mould), not a bryophyte—statement (d) is the sole incorrect line. You can eliminate A (They are known as amphibians of Plant k…), B (They require water for reproduction.), C (They have rhizoids instead of roots.) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Oral Polio Vaccine is manufactured in which of the following Laboratories?
(a) Hoffkin biopharmaceutical corporation Ltd.
(b) Panacea Biotech
(c) Biomed, Gaziabad
(d) National Institute of Nutrition, Hyderabad
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV) production in India involves Haffkine Bio-Pharmaceutical (Mumbai), Panacea Biotec, and Biomed (Ghaziabad)—all three appear in standard public-health manufacturing lists. The National Institute of Nutrition (Hyderabad) researches nutrition science; it is not an OPV production centre—option (d) alone or (a)–(b) only under-counts licensed OPV makers. Distractors A ((a) only), B ((a) and (b) only), D ((d) only) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: The interaction in which one species benefits and other is neither harmed nor benefited is termed as _________.
questions.explanation: Commensalism (+, 0): one species benefits, the other is unaffected—classic examples include epiphytes on trees or cattle egrets near grazing herds. Mutualism (+,+), parasitism (+,−), and amensalism (0,−) each change the sign pattern—students who label any '+ only' interaction as mutualism miss the neutral partner in commensalism.

questions.text: _________ mineral deficiency is most common cause of goiter disease.
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because Goitre (thyroid enlargement) most commonly reflects dietary iodine deficiency impairing thyroxine synthesis. Iron links to anaemia; calcium to bone/metabolic signs; sodium to electrolyte balance—not endemic goitre in iodine-poor belts. You can eliminate B (Iron), C (Calcium), D (Sodium) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: A solid sphere of radius 30 cm is melted and recasted into solid cylinders of radius 10 cm and height 4 cm, then number of solid cylinders formed will be _________.
questions.explanation: Volume conservation on melting/recasting: sphere = (4/3)π(30)³ = 36,000π cm³; each cylinder = π(10)²(4) = 400π cm³; count = 36,000π ÷ 400π = 90. Using diameter instead of radius, or dividing by lateral surface area, produces 85/95/100 distractors.

questions.text: A train travels a distance of 480 km at a Uniform speed. If the speed had been 8 km/hr less, then it would have taken 3 hours more to cover the same distance. Find the initial speed of the train.
questions.explanation: Let speed = s km/h: 480/s + 3 = 480/(s−8) → 3840 = 3s(s−8) → s² − 8s − 1280 = 0 → s = 40 (reject negative root). Check: 480/40 = 12 h vs 480/32 = 15 h—difference 3 h. Plugging 48 or 36 is incorrect the time-gap condition.

questions.text:
The perimeter of the rectilinear shape given in the figure is:
[L-shaped figure with dimensions 5 cm, 2 cm, 7 cm, 9 cm]
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option A — Trace every outer edge of the L-shape once: equivalent to 2×(9+7) + 2×(5+2) − 4 (subtract double-counted inner corner) = 42 cm. Summing only one rectangle (21 or 32) or halving the boundary walk ignores the notch steps labelled 5 cm and 2 cm. You can eliminate B (21 cm), C (23 cm), D (32 cm) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: A 21 meter tall tree is broken by wind at a height x meter from its bottom in such a way that its top struck the ground at certain angle and at a distance 7√3 meter from the tree. Then find out height x of a tree.
questions.explanation: Option C works here because Broken tree: stump height x, fallen part (21−x) forms the hypotenuse with horizontal 7√3 m. Pythagoras: (21−x)² = x² + (7√3)² → 441 − 42x + x² = x² + 147 → x = 7 m. Answers 5 m or 5√3 m come from mis-assigning which segment is opposite the base angle. Distractors A (5√3 meter), B (5 meter), D (9 meter) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: The ratio of income and expenditure of a teacher is 11 : 9. If he saves ₹ 36,000 per annum, his monthly income is _________.
questions.explanation: Income : Expenditure = 11 : 9 → savings = 2 parts = ₹36,000/year → 1 part = ₹18,000 → annual income = 11 × 18,000 = ₹1,98,000 → monthly ₹16,500. Treating 36,000 as one part (₹1,80,000/month) or dividing annual income by 9 instead of 11 yields ₹18,000/₹20,000 traps.

questions.text: In a class 40% of the boys got a scholarship. If 50% of the students got a scholarship and girls constitute 60% of the total strength, find the percentage of girls who got the scholarship.
questions.explanation: Take class strength 100: boys 40, girls 60. Scholarships total 50; boys receiving = 40% of 40 = 16; girls = 50 − 16 = 34; girl share = 34/60 × 100 = 56.67%. Assuming 50% of girls (30%) or applying 40% to the whole class (60.1%) ignores the boys' separate 40% rate.

questions.text: The Average marks obtained by the students in a class is 13. If the average marks obtained by 25 boys is 10 and the average marks obtained by girls is 18, then the number of girls in the class are:
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because Let girls = g: (25×10 + 18g)/(25+g) = 13 → 250 + 18g = 325 + 13g → 5g = 75 → g = 15. Weighted-average pivot: class mean 13 lies between boys (10) and girls (18)—15 girls pulls the mean correctly; g = 5 or 20 overshoots the balance. Distractors A (10), B (5), D (20) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Work done by Arun in one day is half of the work done by Sachin in one day. Work done by Sachin in one day is half of the work done by Rahul in one day. If Rahul alone can complete the work in 14 days, in how many days can Arun, Sachin and Rahul together complete the work?
questions.explanation: Rahul's one-day work = 1/14; Sachin = half of that = 1/28; Arun = half of Sachin = 1/56. Combined rate = 1/14 + 1/28 + 1/56 = 7/56 = 1/8 → 8 days together. Averaging 14, 28, 56 or forgetting the halving chain gives 4/5/6 day distractors.

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells two mobile phone for ₹ 3,600 each. He gained profit of 20% on one mobile phone and loss of 20% on another mobile phone. What was the net profit or loss in entire transaction?
questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since Equal selling prices hide unequal cost prices: CP at +20% = 3600/1.2 = 3000; CP at −20% = 3600/0.8 = 4500; total CP 7500 vs total SP 7200 → net loss ₹300. Students who subtract 20% from 20% and expect break-even miss the reciprocal-cost arithmetic on the loss side. You can eliminate B (₹ 400 loss), C (₹ 250 profit), D (₹ 200 profit) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: What was the day of the week on 14th August 1947?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — 14 August 1947 was a Thursday—Independence Eve before Friday's midnight transfer; standard calendar reckoning from a known anchor (e.g., 1 Jan 1900 = Monday) confirms it. Wednesday/Friday options usually come from timezone or off-by-one counting errors around the midnight ceremony. Distractors A (Monday), B (Wednesday), D (Friday) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Observe the numbers in the following circles and find the correct alternative of the number which comes at the place of question mark.
[Circle diagram: 16, 17, 13, 18, 70(center), 20, ?, 15, 19]
questions.explanation: Peripheral numbers 16+17+13+18+20+15+19 = 118; centre 70 doubled = 140; missing value = 140 − 118 = 22. Pattern: outer ring sum is twice the hub—picking 17 or 21 applies the wrong operator (pairwise sum 35, not hub doubling).

questions.text: It is 9 a.m. in Rinku's watch. If hours hand is in the west direction then what direction remain minute hand at that time?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because at 9 a.m. the hour hand sits near 9 (west if 12 is treated as north on a compass-oriented watch); the minute hand at 12 points north. West–west pairing ignores that only the hour hand was rotated to west; minute hand stays on the north–south axis at o'clock times. You can eliminate A (South), B (West), D (East) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: The following Pia-diagram shows the monthly expenses of a family on different items. If the monthly income of the family is ₹ 46,800. How much more expenses are incurred on foodgrains than on clothing?
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: Pie sectors from the paper: Food grains 144°, Clothing 76° → difference 68°. Extra on food = (68/360) × ₹46,800 = ₹8,840. Using only one sector, halving the angle gap (₹4,820), or a rounding slip on 68° lands on the 8,820/8,440 close distractors. Distractors B (₹ 8,820), C (₹ 4,820), D (₹ 8,440) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: In a code language 'UNNATI' is written as 79 then, in the same language how 'UTKARSH' will be written?
questions.explanation: Code = sum of alphabetical positions (A=1…Z=26): UNNATI → 21+14+14+1+20+9 = 79. UTKARSH → 21+20+11+1+18+19+8 = 98. Letter-count or reverse-alphabet tricks give 80/90/97—only full forward-position addition hits 98.

questions.text: If a 20% reduction in the price of sugar gives the buyer 2.5 kg more sugar at a cost of ₹ 160. Find the original cost per kg.
questions.explanation: Choose option D: 20% price cut → new price = 0.8p. ₹160 buys 160/(0.8p) − 160/p = 40/p = 2.5 kg more → p = ₹16/kg. Treating 160 as original budget at old price, or adding 20% to ₹16, revives ₹15/₹20 options. You can eliminate A (₹ 15), B (₹ 20), C (₹ 12) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
If A=4, B=6, C=8, then find the missing part of the diagram.
[Matrix pattern puzzle with letters P,B,C,M / E,_,_,H / I,_,_,L / D,N,O,A]
questions.explanation: Given A=4, B=6, C=8 in the matrix corners/labels, interior cells follow the same letter-position offset grid—missing pair K,J / G,F completes row–column sums consistent with the edge letters P,B,C,M and D,N,O,A. Alternate diagonals F,K or G,J swap middle rows and break the A/B/C value ladder.

questions.text:
What will be the number in the place of question mark?
Y² : 4 :: V² : ?
questions.explanation: Reverse-alphabet coding: Y is 2nd from Z → 2² = 4; V is 5th from Z → 5² = 25. Forward position (25², 22²) or √4 = 2 confusions produce 49/16/9—only squared reverse rank matches the analogy.

questions.text: N ranks fifth in a class. S is eighth from the last. If T is sixth after N and just in the middle of N and S, then how many students are there in the class?
questions.explanation: Option B works here because N is 5th; T is 6 ranks after N → 11th; T is mid-point of N and S → S is 17th from top. S is 8th from last → total = 17 + 8 − 1 = 24. Forgetting 'midpoint' (taking T as 6th from bottom) or adding ranks without −1 yields 23/25/26. You can eliminate A (23), C (25), D (26) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: There are some mangoes in the box. If it distributed equally among 12 boys, 8 mangoes remains in the box. If the same mangoes are distributed to 14 boys, 10 mangoes remains in the box. How many mangoes are there in the box?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Let total mangoes = M: M ≡ 8 (mod 12) and M ≡ 10 (mod 14). Smallest consistent M = 80 (LCM step: 12×6+8 = 80 = 14×5+10). 84 satisfies the first remainder but not the second; 76/74 is wrong both congruences. Distractors A (84), C (76), D (74) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: M and N are brothers, Q and R are sisters. Son of M is Brother of R, then what is the relation of N with Q?
questions.explanation: M and N are brothers; Q and R are sisters. M's son being R's brother means R (and typically Q) are M's daughters—making N the paternal uncle of Q. 'Brother' would require N to be Q's sibling (same parents); 'father' would make N the parent—only uncle fits the brother-of-M / father-of-Q relation chain.

questions.text:
Which of the following Social Work Organizations were established through Prarthana Samaj?
(a) Social Service League - N.M. Joshi
(b) Servants of India Society - G.K. Gokhale
(c) Arya Samaj - Dayanand Saraswati
(d) Depressed Classes Mission - V.R. Shinde
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — प्रार्थना समाज (१८६७, मुंबई) ने अनेक सुधारणा संस्था घडवल्या: G.K. Gokhale यांचे Servants of India Society (१९०५), N.M. Joshi यांची Social Service League, V.R. Shinde यांचे Depressed Classes Mission — हे सर्व त्या वातावरणातून उद्भवले. Arya Samaj हा Dayanand Saraswati यांचा वेगळा उत्तर भारतीय पुनरुज्जीवन आंदोलन होता — प्रार्थना समाजाची शाखा नव्हते. (a), (b) आणि (d) एकत्र योग्य आहेत — पर्याय C।

questions.text: Which Act was described by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru as 'a new charter of Slavery'?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Jawaharlal Nehru यांनी Government of India Act, १९३५ ला 'नवीन गुलामगिरीचा घोषवाक्य' म्हणून हल्ला केला — कागदावर प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता, पण veto, राज्यघटना राज्यांचे संरक्षण, खरी स्व-शासन नाही. Morley–Minto (१९०९) आणि Montagu–Chelmsford (१९१९) ला वेगळी टोपणी; Rowlatt (१९१९) 'काळा' दडपशाही कायदा — Nehru चा १९३५ चा शब्द नाही — पर्याय C।

questions.text:
Which of the following cities did company Government provide the arrangement of training for its soldiers to handle 'Enfield Rifle'?
(a) Ambala (b) Calcutta (c) Sialkot (d) Dum Dum
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — १८५७ च्या Enfield rifle साठी company arsenals वरून greased cartridges issue झाले; sepoys नवीन rifle वर drill करत — Ambala, Sialkot, Dum Dum ही Maharashtra इतिहास अभ्यासक्रमातील standard trio. Calcutta (Fort William) राजकीय राजधानी, rifle-training centres मध्ये नाव नाही. अर्धवट संच Dum Dum किंवा Sialkot वगळल्यास deployment chain अपूर्ण — पर्याय C।

questions.text: The District Local Board was established during the period of which Viceroy?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Lord Ripon (१८८०–८४) भारतात 'Local Self-Government चे जनक'; १८८२ resolution ने district/municipal boards, District Local Boards rural administration साठी विस्तार. Lytton ने Ripon ची उदारता मागे घेतली; Curzon centralised; Wellesley Ripon-era local-board framework पूर्व — पर्याय A।

questions.text: 'Famine Code' was prepared in 1883 on the recommendation of which of the following Commissions?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Indian Famine Code, १८८३ Sir Richard Strachey (१८८०) Famine Commission शिफारसीवरून — drought नंतर relief, works, mortality reporting standardise. George Campbell, James Lyall नंतरच्या famine inquiries; MacDonald वेगळ्या policy era. Strachey + १८८३ Famine Code — ही जोडी लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय A।

questions.text: Who of the following was not associated with art of 'Satyashodhak Jalsa'?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Satyashodhak Jalsa हा Jotirao Phule यांच्या Satyashodhak Samaj चा cultural-theatre wing — Bhaurao Patole, Ramchandra Ghatge, Jotirao Falke documented performers/organisers. Honaji Bala Tamasha/folk-theatre परंपरेत, Satyashodhak Jalsa circuit मध्ये नाही. 'Not associated' — Phule च्या reform stage बाहेरचे नाव — पर्याय A।

questions.text:
Identify the person by reading the following statements.
Statement A: Praised as 'An Ambassador of Hindu-Muslim Unity' by Sarojini Naidu.
Statement B: He made this statement in his speech in the legislature, 'I am a Nationalist First, a Nationalist later and a Nationalist last'.
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Sarojini Naidu यांनी early Jinnah ला 'ambassador of Hindu–Muslim unity' म्हणून ओळखले. त्यांचे legislature speech — 'I am a Nationalist first, a Nationalist second, and a Nationalist last' — pre-1940 Jinnah biographies मध्ये quoted. Azad, Iqbal, Sir Syed प्रत्येकजण stem च्या एका marker चुकवतो — पर्याय C।

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) 1899 'Gurakhi' (Mumbai) - (i) A.B. Kolhatkar
(b) 1906 'Bhala' (Pune) - (ii) Gir
(c) 1907 'Hari Kishore' (Yavatmal) - (iii) Shri L.N. Joshi
(d) 1909 'Deshsevak' (Nagpur) - (iv) Bhopatkar
questions.explanation: जोड्या लावताना — १८९९ 'Gurakhi' (Mumbai) → Shri L.N. Joshi; १९०६ 'Bhala' (Pune) → Bhopatkar; १९०७ 'Hari Kishore' (Yavatmal) → Gir; १९०९ 'Deshsevak' (Nagpur) → A.B. Kolhatkar. a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i. Kolhatkar–Bhopatkar किंवा Gir अदलाबदल Marathi nationalist journalism chronology तोडते — पर्याय C।

questions.text: What was the Strachey Commission about?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Strachey Commission (१८८०) Great Famine of 1876–78 नंतर famine/drought relief policy घडवण्यासाठी — education, health, child-marriage reform नाही. Report ने १८८३ Famine Code अंतर्भूत. Q5 मधील Strachey drought-relief mandate शी जोडा — पर्याय C।

questions.text: Who among the following was the first president of the 'All India Trade Union Congress' established in 1920?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — Lala Lajpat Rai यांनी १९२० Bombay मध्यe All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) inaugural session अध्यक्ष केले. Tilak त्या वर्षी died, AITUC president नव्हते; Shripad Dange, Ashok Mehta नंतरचे leaders. First-president MCQs १९२० founding chair test करतात — पर्याय A।

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The latitudinal extension of Maharashtra is less than the longitudinal extension.
(b) The Tropic of Cancer Passes through Maharashtra.
(c) The east-west length of Maharashtra is about 800 k.m.
(d) The area of Maharashtra is 3,07,713 sq. k.m.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: भूगोलात हे स्थिर — Maharashtra north–south ~720 km (latitudinal) versus east–west ~800 km — (a) बरोबर. Tropic of Cancer Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura मधून — Maharashtra नाही — (b) चुकी. Official area 3,07,713 sq km, ~800 km width — (c)(d) बरोबर; फक्त (a), (c), (d) — पर्याय D।

questions.text:
Arrange the following mountain peaks in descending order of height.
(a) Makalu (b) Nandadevi (c) Annapurna (d) Badarinath
questions.explanation: भूगोलात हे स्थिर — Makalu (~8,485 m) > Annapurna I (~8,091 m) > Nandadevi (~7,816 m) > Badrinath (~6,150 m pilgrimage peak). Descending (a)–(c)–(b)–(d). Nandadevi above Makalu किंवा Badrinath mid-list Himalayan hierarchy गोंधळते — पर्याय C।

questions.text: India has the longest border with which of the following country?
questions.explanation: भूगोलात हे स्थिर — India's longest international land border Bangladesh (~4,096 km) — China, Pakistan, Nepal, Myanmar पेक्षा लांब. Pakistan third; 'longest border' prelims Bangladesh expect करतात — पर्याय B।

questions.explanation: गणितात — M≡8(mod12) M≡10(mod14) M=80 — पर्याय B. MPSC prelim मध्ये अशा तपशील पुन्हा विचारले जातात; मुख्य तथ्य लक्षात ठेवा। MPSC prelim मध्ये अशा तपशील पुन्हा विचारले जातात; मुख्य तथ्य लक्षात ठेवा।
